| I'm sorry for the bad news, Peter, but we fell 2.0% short of winning this special election.

The reason is simple - Pelosi knew what her donors would think if Republicans won this special election, so she detonated a money bomb in this race to buy her way to victory.

[**We can't allow that to happen again in the general election this November!**](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=451b530a295042aa9133cad312a9a490&_e=QelCQfiuczNroqIxiMPBAJFw9hS9Vhc8V1FBI1xqvOLesLwIMMmmJzaR8cx47ogVUszoLOvVbcNGGRYapl6Aw8n5jqO3EgE2SL56KMhfmxQuAuTmz5iTGpHv85oRtHqKq7VnH7sFBPH4jam8o3Oz7xdnQsbdlaYQQG87Y-AiC_ujDHp-O7RtQ95dtIAWU6-5f5NUASSmZpmag3wOfzOYO8QFBk3pSsG_08UAwwliUbDkGk63Se8adqhFs-PU04JLu5bui2qI38FLKLCG17x5NfErENFJIn2V5IpuZ5YZPLHFtUHyKOk-YPQ6jcUC20iVNOSSGDBLjcERVOvM6l0XbLuRT5Y4QxfKdst9vnbE2WZ_wQlKwwszUrZKxX7qJEXxxHMGydT_HU3MWUAd_ByFGg%3D%3D)

If we're going to have any chance of winning back Congress, then we need to regroup, refocus, and throw everything we have at winning the newly redrawn district.

[**But, to do that I need to know if you're still with me, Peter. Be honest, do you still want Republicans to win back the House from Pelosi?**](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=451b530a295042aa9133cad312a9a490&_e=QelCQfiuczNroqIxiMPBAJFw9hS9Vhc8V1FBI1xqvOLesLwIMMmmJzaR8cx47ogVUszoLOvVbcNGGRYapl6Aw8n5jqO3EgE2SL56KMhfmxQuAuTmz5iTGpHv85oRtHqKq7VnH7sFBPH4jam8o3Oz7xdnQsbdlaYQQG87Y-AiC_ujDHp-O7RtQ95dtIAWU6-5f5NUASSmZpmag3wOfzOYO8QFBk3pSsG_08UAwwliUbDkGk63Se8adqhFs-PU04JLbHPwbykTZZiV7ujjRruaS6PaBKGhk2HfJfbrsbfMkpHb2Wyee88ciYhfEKvXNSyGcCvizxksFEevBjmBAxJSw4GoMWf7ymBSaFzf9fI599PAv8mtn_YtN7kMW9miFzI-gAmmTTdKRia-mYhMEASlqg%3D%3D)

[**I CHANGED MY MIND - I WANT THE DEMOCRATS TO WIN**](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=451b530a295042aa9133cad312a9a490&_e=QelCQfiuczNroqIxiMPBAJFw9hS9Vhc8V1FBI1xqvOLesLwIMMmmJzaR8cx47ogVUszoLOvVbcNGGRYapl6Aw8n5jqO3EgE2SL56KMhfmxQuAuTmz5iTGpHv85oRtHqKq7VnH7sFBPH4jam8o3Oz7xdnQsbdlaYQQG87Y-AiC_ujDHp-O7RtQ95dtIAWU6-5f5NUASSmZpmag3wOfzOYO8QFBk3pSsG_08UAwwliUbDkGk63Se8adqhFs-PU04JLOQyyjVlkA9XmW3eEKnF5RM09MlrNmnqGeiRKf_hruSZMzgNbeUAhnNXhGCXSDGnEqfFmIstRG4svJhsgavaVaF1OQLafCn8wgcoV1gvXRl8Y8HM6DZolpaTod1pk8mznrEYhJCqJNQfjhMe5SVZwOA%3D%3D)
Please don't take this question lightly, Peter. **_If you're not with me in this fight then I need to know now because this isn't going to get easier._**

This was always going to be an uphill battle, and this special election loss proves that Washington Democrats are willing to say and spend anything to score a victory.

[**But, we have to pick ourselves up and get back in the fight**](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=451b530a295042aa9133cad312a9a490&_e=QelCQfiuczNroqIxiMPBAJFw9hS9Vhc8V1FBI1xqvOLesLwIMMmmJzaR8cx47ogVUszoLOvVbcNGGRYapl6Aw8n5jqO3EgE2SL56KMhfmxQuAuTmz5iTGpHv85oRtHqKq7VnH7sFBPH4jam8o3Oz7xdnQsbdlaYQQG87Y-AiC_ujDHp-O7RtQ95dtIAWU6-5f5NUASSmZpmag3wOfzOYO8QFBk3pSsG_08UAwwliUbDkGk63Se8adqhFs-PU04JLM326yObNzbrvwts48LYattxSdmIT-jpwSFiCI4cvj7IS4EjPmh69zDEEdxtkP7GEimrGlu6RZKyv9ZQdYhUsOFdTZDGy_T6XEeDwjiWp8FUoeLjkzwcUEscuyhaedI1xoUJ9a-QK5Ka3WAnlP3bBfA%3D%3D) so we can prevent our country from falling deeper into the pockets of Hollywood and radical special interests!

[**STAND WITH MARC AND THE GOP**](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=451b530a295042aa9133cad312a9a490&_e=QelCQfiuczNroqIxiMPBAJFw9hS9Vhc8V1FBI1xqvOLesLwIMMmmJzaR8cx47ogVUszoLOvVbcNGGRYapl6Aw8n5jqO3EgE2SL56KMhfmxQuAuTmz5iTGpHv85oRtHqKq7VnH7sFBPH4jam8o3Oz7xdnQsbdlaYQQG87Y-AiC_ujDHp-O7RtQ95dtIAWU6-5f5NUASSmZpmag3wOfzOYO8QFBk3pSsG_08UAwwliUbDkGk63Se8adqhFs-PU04JLOn8HtQ2UfEPfAC_tASSyV74dJ83aC7omSAbDIdXqhbY-hskw3KmlcTPUx-WX7N4T7u1sA8h0hlEbrvtbhwoyvRbSQWLxTWvtPG1SZ-IK8v4tAZFsZiecFK7JREfLINZegENBdjmzW9U4Daldn7b_iQ%3D%3D)
If you're still with me in this fight to win back Congress in November, [**then please let me know before midnight tonight, so I can see who I'm able to count on still.**](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=451b530a295042aa9133cad312a9a490&_e=QelCQfiuczNroqIxiMPBAJFw9hS9Vhc8V1FBI1xqvOLesLwIMMmmJzaR8cx47ogVUszoLOvVbcNGGRYapl6Aw8n5jqO3EgE2SL56KMhfmxQuAuTmz5iTGpHv85oRtHqKq7VnH7sFBPH4jam8o3Oz7xdnQsbdlaYQQG87Y-AiC_ujDHp-O7RtQ95dtIAWU6-5f5NUASSmZpmag3wOfzOYO8QFBk3pSsG_08UAwwliUbDkGk63Se8adqhFs-PU04JL_CnMSV3u8ZWOUPUwAGjKpM9GRLUhnx6Y05a6ze7CP0w3mkmhudoivReHuNhyKSbHCotQ9XNXFs34KIW-FNDGh4Ob7j3XrLFO0Am2GuPXnn7SVLei6eMXcFnHaT8O4iVMOuGrzcO33CUusdIRCStcrw%3D%3D)

The short version: I’m up against the clock on my monthly fundraising deadline and will miss it unless we take action immediately. Remember, I’m running in a district we barely flipped in 2020, and fighting tooth and nail to keep in red. The long version: This is what I didn’t want to have to send you, Fellow American. I know how bad things are right now. People are struggling to afford rent, buy groceries, and fill up their tank at the gas pump. I’ve been there. Like a lot of Americans, I struggled to make ends meet, living paycheck to paycheck. _"Democrats control the Senate now by virtue of Raphael Warnock's 93,272-vote victory over incumbent Kelly Loeffler in one of Georgia's [2020] runoff contests"_
_-- Cook Political Report_
Peter,

**Democrats are giddy because their chances to keep running Washington are improving by the day.**

This new headline from the non-partisan _Cook Political Report_ says it all:

[](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=98deb6c5e29f4c01b9231cfb6dd06d91&_e=Vnm0jBRlljpg7PTtBvNnKaeEBvLItqCOYSFhLH8DMGGe0TIxlgY-dPlQGwDI2lcrruJZU-YLm3Rid9bcenTuO4Lr_9Rnj_R4m78QWUFtf0OgeYJr6Qn5hIFnn6g39puRVjsJ6zqynttVxIBwEgG1jcQB_YHS_D_ioFy2HUHGHPGud6fvWsswYdQYUtTe12LcNrR3DODznx4oSPDnx_Xw7DmPoyS2ABEiYioS51C3skPcvZT5qZcDMExNmQrpqQiMmdeDmhdVbqMqRo8bSD3rea7Co9iCtkUiI6O9lK2vp64dKcdXv9n087wPRcobDoLuaSavCMeHRVB6x0OLoniwCd0Cq4v0eKTUQZqxsmMYhCa_FZxxnyzTU_mpNHTKo35RIwuFDubcBEjVfKs04Sw1soe3LEJqDwAYazGo0sNXWPIJy3kxTH0dWycTVsFuCeO8)
The Senate is up for grabs and could go either way, but it's clear we can't rely on a national "Red Wave" to sweep us to victory. Instead, we've got to build and run our own campaign in Georgia to convince voters it is time for a change.

**And that's EXACTLY WHAT WE ARE DOING.**

Sparknotes

| [](http://links.jdforohio.org/u/click?_t=52e88da6462b43fd9dbbfea97c7983e9&_m=6ad29effdc6a4f70a20552fe1ce9872c&_e=cZizMbEhK3mawO5_-pal766CZ5ky9pRQeZjoY34IvYLeRDYuVQ9A_xZkr7yu8A0OLOJgGWa_8DiE9wKdcqEj0vUZoVtcsIse_X0g6jo9xbGbXW8uBm4botun3SBr5ZUMW--7md9FTX2zJCYjKr7xsdIIlo-vwxsnyLvmcQRmg8IzgRr6jOb2qYOAJ4Ez197Cvy4Qto-DCK6LmpcSCiMqocrOO55ADjI2kPGejDkCYgrb8G39rZSfQIi5SPME4Rp7RieZVg4NNbvZNxxuo9ZTgoEo-oPs0tjN8CRJnvCsuF0vhiO5c5FTMfGXgAUtnoxaPv4I6Z5q7SX8TOO23tSxPngzdHmcHNwvAMbrzm1740nMIq5bQXkf8yPsN3P18IBD5g_Q_bJy3QWiUA1jKYUGsRR3G5Hwft5HIWuQj0YFsjcwEcoLGd8IO8SmQyDsumVVVD1nfqGMFsM6ihEX0vDwHy56oClZDvT5c5w1UWCsRbY%3D)
---
Friends,

I thought I’d take a second to tell you how I got here – running for the U.S. Senate. There’s so much to tell, and I want all of you to know why I am so determined to fight for the forgotten men and women of this country. Let me give you the Sparknotes version of my _Hillbilly Elegy._
[](http://links.jdforohio.org/u/click?_t=52e88da6462b43fd9dbbfea97c7983e9&_m=6ad29effdc6a4f70a20552fe1ce9872c&_e=cZizMbEhK3mawO5_-pal766CZ5ky9pRQeZjoY34IvYLeRDYuVQ9A_xZkr7yu8A0OLOJgGWa_8DiE9wKdcqEj0vUZoVtcsIse_X0g6jo9xbGbXW8uBm4botun3SBr5ZUMW--7md9FTX2zJCYjKr7xsdIIlo-vwxsnyLvmcQRmg8IzgRr6jOb2qYOAJ4Ez197Cvy4Qto-DCK6LmpcSCiMqocrOO55ADjI2kPGejDkCYgrb8G39rZSfQIi5SPME4Rp7RieZVg4NNbvZNxxuo9ZTgoEo-oPs0tjN8CRJnvCsuF3jlw-DzwQt1e2TtO4nA9Ld9hRcJS0Ux3ktx9oTeVeV_E9jfEyHAIeoD1_0vCwXXzDvZVNWqZl1IOsJcgtsZ9kpAD6XAxXa5ZnLWf8q0WFJdl7-VRCoTKUeFk2S5SOW8OXV6abOVbYxeDaF6_g-yDYPyByc2dIcP64fl7xVn1XLj9ltBA82EmVGD4COh5GoAYM%3D)
This is a photo of my sister, Lindsay, and me. We grew up in the manufacturing town of Middletown, Ohio. We grew up in a dysfunctional house without a constant father figure. My mother struggled with drug and alcohol addiction. I recall an episode when I was eleven when my mother and I got in a heated argument and I climbed into the back of the car. She eventually pulled over, I got out of the car, and she chased me across a field. The drama and family turbulence was nonstop.
[](http://links.jdforohio.org/u/click?_t=52e88da6462b43fd9dbbfea97c7983e9&_m=6ad29effdc6a4f70a20552fe1ce9872c&_e=cZizMbEhK3mawO5_-pal766CZ5ky9pRQeZjoY34IvYLeRDYuVQ9A_xZkr7yu8A0OLOJgGWa_8DiE9wKdcqEj0vUZoVtcsIse_X0g6jo9xbGbXW8uBm4botun3SBr5ZUMW--7md9FTX2zJCYjKr7xsdIIlo-vwxsnyLvmcQRmg8IzgRr6jOb2qYOAJ4Ez197Cvy4Qto-DCK6LmpcSCiMqocrOO55ADjI2kPGejDkCYgrb8G39rZSfQIi5SPME4Rp7RieZVg4NNbvZNxxuo9ZTgoEo-oPs0tjN8CRJnvCsuF3jlw-DzwQt1e2TtO4nA9Ld9hRcJS0Ux3ktx9oTeVeV_Lj9tcnZzshYBvdxHFMWn0_wfxHyTGI5lpDpPQGpoF_-PAhlQPKECj-fY_CCcVbmz7ZsX-VsNHazjU4gluhL_EQDc36JxaDpUoGxe5b7Lqiny3S7OiUTJS1iRdHp743Ahn0EZzo-lqFg38tc4DpZGCc%3D)
My sister and I eventually moved in with my grandparents – Mamaw and Papaw. Pictured here is me and Mamaw. Her and Papaw were, without question or qualification, the best things that ever happened to me. They spent the last two decades of their lives showing me the value of love and stability and teaching me the life lessons that most people learn from their parents. Both did their part to ensure that I had the self-confidence and the right opportunities to get a fair shot at the American Dream.
[](http://links.jdforohio.org/u/click?_t=52e88da6462b43fd9dbbfea97c7983e9&_m=6ad29effdc6a4f70a20552fe1ce9872c&_e=cZizMbEhK3mawO5_-pal766CZ5ky9pRQeZjoY34IvYLeRDYuVQ9A_xZkr7yu8A0OLOJgGWa_8DiE9wKdcqEj0vUZoVtcsIse_X0g6jo9xbGbXW8uBm4botun3SBr5ZUMW--7md9FTX2zJCYjKr7xsdIIlo-vwxsnyLvmcQRmg8IzgRr6jOb2qYOAJ4Ez197Cvy4Qto-DCK6LmpcSCiMqocrOO55ADjI2kPGejDkCYgrb8G39rZSfQIi5SPME4Rp7RieZVg4NNbvZNxxuo9ZTgoEo-oPs0tjN8CRJnvCsuF3jlw-DzwQt1e2TtO4nA9Ld9hRcJS0Ux3ktx9oTeVeV_NfG5JH2g8L13lKk7tohcOuLWjV63lAJa-w7373DwX7SN9MToivbXMQKs6OnxAA4ibqqMtL8fWrKLYqGFzcgIYFVg69ICkX3uYGwaKMz-3jXdwvfMhymPdaw8GygVQ2wlNKFYOYPDSjYUo1Vdiz8P2M%3D)
After high school, I decided to enlist in the Marine Corps. I served in the Iraq War performing public affairs activities. I served for four years before returning home to Ohio, where I became a first-generation college graduate at the Ohio State University.
[](http://links.jdforohio.org/u/click?_t=52e88da6462b43fd9dbbfea97c7983e9&_m=6ad29effdc6a4f70a20552fe1ce9872c&_e=cZizMbEhK3mawO5_-pal766CZ5ky9pRQeZjoY34IvYLeRDYuVQ9A_xZkr7yu8A0OLOJgGWa_8DiE9wKdcqEj0vUZoVtcsIse_X0g6jo9xbGbXW8uBm4botun3SBr5ZUMW--7md9FTX2zJCYjKr7xsdIIlo-vwxsnyLvmcQRmg8IzgRr6jOb2qYOAJ4Ez197Cvy4Qto-DCK6LmpcSCiMqocrOO55ADjI2kPGejDkCYgrb8G39rZSfQIi5SPME4Rp7RieZVg4NNbvZNxxuo9ZTgoEo-oPs0tjN8CRJnvCsuF3jlw-DzwQt1e2TtO4nA9Ld9hRcJS0Ux3ktx9oTeVeV_PzvPWFotYgzp6Ay1EkPxPBRXZITn5I5U09RSivi88T0YBuusFcN_SELSYPgXABrf4UhZFdNWi-v3YgDYbNYnisba41MY6qgR-hRAa45wtwEc2u8JSajHLj_JBBrjzl14jI15drbLK_qymlyw2gMyrY%3D)
I then went on to attend Yale Law School, where I met the love of my life, Usha. She showed me kindness and patience, all while guiding me through the trauma and baggage I held onto from my childhood. We married in 2014 and now have three beautiful children together.
[](http://links.jdforohio.org/u/click?_t=52e88da6462b43fd9dbbfea97c7983e9&_m=6ad29effdc6a4f70a20552fe1ce9872c&_e=cZizMbEhK3mawO5_-pal766CZ5ky9pRQeZjoY34IvYLeRDYuVQ9A_xZkr7yu8A0OLOJgGWa_8DiE9wKdcqEj0vUZoVtcsIse_X0g6jo9xbGbXW8uBm4botun3SBr5ZUMW--7md9FTX2zJCYjKr7xsdIIlo-vwxsnyLvmcQRmg8IzgRr6jOb2qYOAJ4Ez197Cvy4Qto-DCK6LmpcSCiMqocrOO55ADjI2kPGejDkCYgrb8G39rZSfQIi5SPME4Rp7RieZVg4NNbvZNxxuo9ZTgoEo-oPs0tjN8CRJnvCsuF3jlw-DzwQt1e2TtO4nA9Ld9hRcJS0Ux3ktx9oTeVeV_MDyTcCPLcXVqvBDYPHuO7SLWr9y3mINZHVW8OnZ7L7nif2t851T1tMCO8Uo2uOXIjbhgQ8b-TT1y-DqW26008YqALgKbZmIQmXdMdUhan4MHG7VglQEDVLzF-KPJL4_WJ7l8j3Wv0IDKkQyMY66P6I%3D)
All of this brought me to where I am right now – campaigning to be Ohio’s next Senator. After the success of my book, I began working to fiercely defend working-class Americans against the media and political elite who have ignored us for so long. I’ve seen too many lives devastated by job loss, addiction, and economic turmoil to stay silent.

I think so many politicians are lost in the establishment. They fail their constituents, their country, and ultimately – they fail themselves. It’s an industry of broken promises and corrupt practices. But I will never stoop to that level. My roots – my family – my hometown – are what got me here. The good and the bad.
[](http://links.jdforohio.org/u/click?_t=52e88da6462b43fd9dbbfea97c7983e9&_m=6ad29effdc6a4f70a20552fe1ce9872c&_e=cZizMbEhK3mawO5_-pal766CZ5ky9pRQeZjoY34IvYLeRDYuVQ9A_xZkr7yu8A0OLOJgGWa_8DiE9wKdcqEj0vUZoVtcsIse_X0g6jo9xbGbXW8uBm4botun3SBr5ZUMW--7md9FTX2zJCYjKr7xsdIIlo-vwxsnyLvmcQRmg8IzgRr6jOb2qYOAJ4Ez197Cvy4Qto-DCK6LmpcSCiMqocrOO55ADjI2kPGejDkCYgrb8G39rZSfQIi5SPME4Rp7RieZVg4NNbvZNxxuo9ZTgoEo-oPs0tjN8CRJnvCsuF3jlw-DzwQt1e2TtO4nA9Ld9hRcJS0Ux3ktx9oTeVeV_M9_W3UDWxCljVc3pqIgDDQbcniJyl16hvbEME0s5feJ3xg7NHS4Lcqxb_GKA4NS4cwI9kcpYZn6ZQFy-2n5yRHAXk2Tefvg_GcqJWzxbrjIsXzhOnutTHrfIqbDndljZIZ7m_Brm60Ai5WYnNySDHQ%3D)
I will never let you down or leave you behind. The Senate needs someone who knows what it’s like to live in a left-behind community, not a career politician who has done nothing for the people of Ohio.

I feel incredibly lucky and blessed to be where I am. Looking through these pictures reminds me of the core of this campaign: **leave no Ohioan behind.**

[**_It would be the honor of my life to serve you in the Senate, and I hope you can make a donation today. It would truly mean the world to me._**](http://links.jdforohio.org/u/click?_t=52e88da6462b43fd9dbbfea97c7983e9&_m=6ad29effdc6a4f70a20552fe1ce9872c&_e=cZizMbEhK3mawO5_-pal766CZ5ky9pRQeZjoY34IvYLeRDYuVQ9A_xZkr7yu8A0OLOJgGWa_8DiE9wKdcqEj0vUZoVtcsIse_X0g6jo9xbGbXW8uBm4botun3SBr5ZUMW--7md9FTX2zJCYjKr7xsdIIlo-vwxsnyLvmcQRmg8IzgRr6jOb2qYOAJ4Ez197Cvy4Qto-DCK6LmpcSCiMqocrOO55ADjI2kPGejDkCYgrb8G39rZSfQIi5SPME4Rp7RieZVg4NNbvZNxxuo9ZTgoEo-oPs0tjN8CRJnvCsuF3jlw-DzwQt1e2TtO4nA9Ld9hRcJS0Ux3ktx9oTeVeV_Pm2fThm0Kx-X5wvYSxX8fnIOLnBFlbtb1Xt53rsSRak6IpzcC8wRrN89CyLl6AKI_P-FBPjgPQp6cTN5VJavQg1nB-jSZ4anacNiEpefTlNFO3Kc3e1LUlbDFzMAfnHn9fuIdbLaxBnPcJ09RdJyxU%3D)
[**JOIN TEAM JD!**](http://links.jdforohio.org/u/click?_t=52e88da6462b43fd9dbbfea97c7983e9&_m=6ad29effdc6a4f70a20552fe1ce9872c&_e=cZizMbEhK3mawO5_-pal766CZ5ky9pRQeZjoY34IvYLeRDYuVQ9A_xZkr7yu8A0OLOJgGWa_8DiE9wKdcqEj0vUZoVtcsIse_X0g6jo9xbGbXW8uBm4botun3SBr5ZUMW--7md9FTX2zJCYjKr7xsdIIlo-vwxsnyLvmcQRmg8IzgRr6jOb2qYOAJ4Ez197Cvy4Qto-DCK6LmpcSCiMqocrOO55ADjI2kPGejDkCYgrb8G39rZSfQIi5SPME4Rp7RieZVg4NNbvZNxxuo9ZTgoEo-oPs0tjN8CRJnvCsuF3jlw-DzwQt1e2TtO4nA9Ld9hRcJS0Ux3ktx9oTeVeV_Oh_tPgmPZg80sAHG7jaa0RzaFWdBr_ltQ69NvUHSebR4aUpjdOjl6mjh0CJLkrIS23ddW717MgUkAG4K2lLsjEQiUTmdCjMS_doT-I7Rj6T_3HbH5o_-O684hHoCqBBuzWCpmK0QlF7LgjHH8y_lQ8%3D)
Thank you so much for taking the time to read.

God bless,

JD Vance

**Conservative Outsider. Marine. Businessman. Author.**
Ohio needs a true conservative in the U.S. Senate. It needs someone who understands how our

clean_body: Sparknotes | Friends, I thought I’d take a second to tell you how I got here – running for the U.S. Senate. There’s so much to tell, and I want all of you to know why I am so determined to fight for the forgotten men and women of this country. Let me give you the Sparknotes version of my Hillbilly Elegy. This is a photo of my sister, Lindsay, and me. We grew up in the manufacturing town of Middletown, Ohio. We grew up in a dysfunctional house without a constant father figure. My mother struggled with drug and alcohol addiction. I recall an episode when I was eleven when my mother and I got in a heated argument and I climbed into the back of the car. She eventually pulled over, I got out of the car, and she chased me across a field. The drama and family turbulence was nonstop. My sister and I eventually moved in with my grandparents – Mamaw and Papaw. Pictured here is me and Mamaw. Her and Papaw were, without question or qualification, the best things that ever happened to me. They spent the last two decades of their lives showing me the value of love and stability and teaching me the life lessons that most people learn from their parents. Both did their part to ensure that I had the self-confidence and the right opportunities to get a fair shot at the American Dream. After high school, I decided to enlist in the Marine Corps. I served in the Iraq War performing public affairs activities. I served for four years before returning home to Ohio, where I became a first-generation college graduate at the Ohio State University. I then went on to attend Yale Law School, where I met the love of my life, Usha. She showed me kindness and patience, all while guiding me through the trauma and baggage I held onto from my childhood. We married in 2014 and now have three beautiful children together. All of this brought me to where I am right now – campaigning to be Ohio’s next Senator. After the success of my book, I began working to fiercely defend working-class Americans against the media and political elite who have ignored us for so long. I’ve seen too many lives devastated by job loss, addiction, and economic turmoil to stay silent. I think so many politicians are lost in the establishment. They fail their constituents, their country, and ultimately – they fail themselves. It’s an industry of broken promises and corrupt practices. But I will never stoop to that level. My roots – my family – my hometown – are what got me here. The good and the bad. I will never let you down or leave you behind. The Senate needs someone who knows what it’s like to live in a left-behind community, not a career politician who has done nothing for the people of Ohio. I feel incredibly lucky and blessed to be where I am. Looking through these pictures reminds me of the core of this campaign: leave no Ohioan behind. Thank you so much for taking the time to read. God bless, JD Vance Conservative Outsider. Marine. Businessman. Author. Ohio needs a true conservative in the U.S. Senate. It needs someone who understands how our economic and government leaders conspire to make life harder for normal Americans. Ohio needs JD Vance. Immediately after Harvey, when I went door to door to check on some of our low-income seniors, I learned that there were a significant number whose health was at risk because they were not removing flood-soiled sheetrock from their homes. **It broke my heart, but I wasn’t elected to have a broken heart; I was elected to do something.** _So I got to work, mobilizing hundreds of volunteers to canvass low-income senior communities and provide them with assistance over the years._

I helped seniors like Ms. Kaverna Moore, who had a hole in her floor, right down to the bottom, and multiple feet of water in her house, yet was denied assistance from FEMA. It wasn’t until I had a New York Times reporter write a story about her that she was able to get the FEMA assistance she needed.

I helped to rebuild the home of 85-year-old Mr. Brown, who had suffered in silence without help since Harvey. Over the past 5 years, I have been in the homes of countless numbers of seniors to help them get aid and home repair. **In that journey, I became too familiar with what unmitigated disrepair over 5 years can result in for our seniors.**

5 years later, I'm still out in the community, ensuring that our most vulnerable residents – low-income seniors – get the help they need because that's what servant leaders do, but I can’t do it alone.

As we commemorate 5 years after Harvey, we must become more motivated to help those seniors who suffer in silence by meeting them where they are in their communities. We must also believe them when they say they need help and aid them with navigating their complicated cases through a system that makes it difficult to access help. We cannot allow our seniors to be left behind on our road to recovery.

clean_body: Harvey marks one of the worst disasters in U.S. history. | | | | | It’s so hard to believe that 5 years have passed since Harvey devastated our region. 51 inches of rainfall, thousands of homes damaged, and $125 billion in damage resulted in the second worst disaster in U.S. history. What is even worse is that so many of our residents – in particular, our low-income seniors – remain in need. Immediately after Harvey, when I went door to door to check on some of our low-income seniors, I learned that there were a significant number whose health was at risk because they were not removing flood-soiled sheetrock from their homes. It broke my heart, but I wasn’t elected to have a broken heart; I was elected to do something. So I got to work, mobilizing hundreds of volunteers to canvass low-income senior communities and provide them with assistance over the years. I helped seniors like Ms. Kaverna Moore, who had a hole in her floor, right down to the bottom, and multiple feet of water in her house, yet was denied assistance from FEMA. It wasn’t until I had a New York Times reporter write a story about her that she was able to get the FEMA assistance she needed. I helped to rebuild the home of 85-year-old Mr. Brown, who had suffered in silence without help since Harvey. Over the past 5 years, I have been in the homes of countless numbers of seniors to help them get aid and home repair. In that journey, I became too familiar with what unmitigated disrepair over 5 years can result in for our seniors. 5 years later, I'm still out in the community, ensuring that our most vulnerable residents – low-income seniors – get the help they need because that's what servant leaders do, but I can’t do it alone. As we commemorate 5 years after Harvey, we must become more motivated to help those seniors who suffer in silence by meeting them where they are in their communities. We must also believe them when they say they need help and aid them with navigating their complicated cases through a system that makes it difficult to access help. We cannot allow our seniors to be left behind on our road to recovery. If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: We need a mayor who is committed to making sure that our seniors have a full recovery post-Harvey. I remain committed to honoring the stories of the past and meeting the community where it is in order to find those who still need help. Together, Amanda K. Edwards Amanda K. body:
Judicial Watch President Tom Fitton made the following statement regarding the Department of Justice’s (DOJ) highly redacted affidavit released in response to Judicial Watch’s court request to unseal the warrant materials used in the unprecedented raid on the home of former President Trump.

| | |
---
---
| | | Because no one is above the law! | Aug 29, 2022
---|---|---
## Today's Top Stories
| | | | [](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=59999&L=27949&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvdHJ1bXAtcmFpZC1hZmZpZGF2aXQtcmVsZWFzZWQvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249dGlwc2hlZXQmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==) | **[Judicial Watch Victory: Trump Raid Affidavit Released](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=59999&L=27949&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvdHJ1bXAtcmFpZC1hZmZpZGF2aXQtcmVsZWFzZWQvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249dGlwc2hlZXQmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==)** In a remarkable and historic victory for transparency, Judicial Watch today forced the release of the infamous and heavily redacted Trump raid affidavit. Now we know why the Biden Justice Department did not want to release this material, as it exposes how there was significant evidence of President Trump’s cooperation, a major legal dispute about the legal status of the records believed to be in Trump’s possession, and that the FBI abusively raided his home anyway. [READ MORE](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=59999&L=27949&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvdHJ1bXAtcmFpZC1hZmZpZGF2aXQtcmVsZWFzZWQvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249dGlwc2hlZXQmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==)

name: Katie Britt
subject: I have nothing to apologize for
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Britt for Alabama, Inc
body:
| | | Peter, I'm not sorry.
I'm not sorry for being a momma on a mission and let me tell you why. I'm a mother of two young children who are packing up their new school supplies, grabbing their lunches off the kitchen table, and piling in the car to take on a new school year & all it has to offer. Every year, the night before my son and daughter start a new school year, we pray together as a family. We pray for a year full of endless opportunities, an abundance of learning, and limitless growth. Our children and grandchildren ARE the future of our great nation and we owe it to them to put Alabama first. Wait - I'm jumping ahead, Peter. Let me take a step back and introduce myself. I'm Katie Britt and I'm running for the U.S. Senate because I firmly believe it's time to fight for the next generation and preserve the American Dream for our children. When I first announced I was running for the Senate, I heard reason after reason why I should NOT throw my hat in the ring. But I have two EVEN BIGGER reasons why I decided to block out the noise and dive headfirst into this race: Their names are Bennett and Ridgeway. My school-aged daughter and son who continually remind me "God calls us to do hard things."
---
[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61135494:6bwwuEVNh:m:1:3317145305:E8B9E9B5E6C1C1F7157985A3DFFD830E:r)
---
| | **Let me be clear.** My children are my driving force, but this campaign is about EVERY child. From the little ones entering their first day of kindergarten to the high-school seniors day-dreaming about what the future holds - _I 'm fighting for them._ _But, this campaign is also about you. _ _It 's about _**_our_** _children and grandchildren. __
__It 's about every student, parent, and family.__ _**_It 's about the future of America._** I'll be honest with you, Peter. I never in a MILLION YEARS thought I'd be writing you an email like this, because I never thought that I, a mom of two who became a mother while still putting herself through law school, would be a candidate for the United States Senate. But then again, if anyone knows about persistence and hard work, it's this girl.
---
[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61135494:6bwwuEVNh:m:1:3317145305:E8B9E9B5E6C1C1F7157985A3DFFD830E:r)
---
I'm a public school grad from the Wiregrass who watched her parents work six, sometimes seven, days a week just to make ends meet. My dad, my role model, would come home, exhausted from a long day's work, and still make sure to ask me about my school day, what subjects were giving me trouble, and to help me with my math homework and book reports. _My parents gave me a front row seat to watch the American Dream in action_ , and I learned to never take a single day for granted. Beyond that, they taught me what it meant to be my unapologetic self - a devoted Christian, a fearless leader, and a proud conservative. **Let me say that one more time, Peter.** I'm a **devoted Christian** who is dedicated to supporting every child from the womb to the workforce. I'm a **fearless leader** who will stand up for every child, parent, and family. And I'm a **proud conservative** who knows education is the key to opportunity, which is at the heart of the American Dream. Providing children with access to high-quality educational options early is critical to their success later in life.
That is why I strongly believe in school choice: every single Alabama child deserves the best possible education - **regardless of their zip code.**
Peter, you and I both know the jobs of TOMORROW require quality education now, and I am dedicated to supporting Alabama's children TODAY. **[_Our children are going to need every leg up we can give them if we want them to succeed while learning and working in a nation ruled by Radicals like Joe Biden._](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61135494:6bwwuEVNh:m:1:3317145305:E8B9E9B5E6C1C1F7157985A3DFFD830E:r) ** Earlier in this email I mentioned I was a _momma on a mission_. That has been my motto since my daughter, Bennett, made me a mother. From that day forward, I lived for my daughter. And then when my son, Ridgeway, came along I lived for them both. I've made every single decision with them in mind, and I will continue to do that every day as a United States Senator. It's my job as a mother to fight tooth and nail for my children. And, if elected in November, I will proudly expand on my role as a momma on a mission and fight for every American child as if they were my own. [_**If you 're able to join me in the fight for our children - and our nation - I hope you'll consider making an immediate contribution of any amount to bolster my campaign. A donation from a fellow conservative like you will make all the difference in this battle for the next generation.**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61135494:6bwwuEVNh:m:1:3317145305:E8B9E9B5E6C1C1F7157985A3DFFD830E:r) Thank you in advance for your support,
---
[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61135494:6bwwuEVNh:m:1:3317145305:E8B9E9B5E6C1C1F7157985A3DFFD830E:r)
---
Katie Britt Mother of Bennett & RidgewayCandidate for U.S. Senate [__P.S. - I 've been a staunch supporter of Alabama's voluntary First Class Pre-K program, which has been ranked as the nation's best for 16 consecutive years, because I know that parents know what's best for their children. We're just starting to send our kids back to school, and there's no better time than RIGHT NOW to make a contribution. Without your donation, I'm afraid we won't have the necessary resources to stand up to Biden and the Radical Left when they try to take away even more choices and opportunities from our innocent children.__](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61135494:6bwwuEVNh:m:1:3317145305:E8B9E9B5E6C1C1F7157985A3DFFD830E:r)
---

Beyond that, they taught me what it meant to be my unapologetic self - a devoted Christian, a fearless leader, and a proud conservative. Let me say that one more time, Peter. I'm a devoted Christian who is dedicated to supporting every child from the womb to the workforce. I'm a fearless leader who will stand up for every child, parent, and family. And I'm a proud conservative who knows education is the key to opportunity, which is at the heart of the American Dream. Providing children with access to high-quality educational options early is critical to their success later in life. That is why I strongly believe in school choice: every single Alabama child deserves the best possible education - regardless of their zip code. Peter, you and I both know the jobs of TOMORROW require quality education now, and I am dedicated to supporting Alabama's children TODAY. Earlier in this email I mentioned I was a momma on a mission_. That has been my motto since my daughter, Bennett, made me a mother. From that day forward, I lived for my daughter. And then when my son, Ridgeway, came along I lived for them both. I've made every single decision with them in mind, and I will continue to do that every day as a United States Senator. It's my job as a mother to fight tooth and nail for my children. And, if elected in November, I will proudly expand on my role as a momma on a mission and fight for every American child as if they were my own. Thank you in advance for your support, Katie Britt Mother of Bennett & RidgewayCandidate for U.S. Senate | | Paid for by Britt for Alabama, Inc. name: Great America Update
subject: Your invitation: National Survey on Socialism
body:
A few years ago, New York magazine posed the question: “When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?” [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c612934%7c6382%7c6%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c1&wdmdk=9phM7FJ9NTEu1JjCciTEhw&sysid=1)
| | | This sponsored message from Great America Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c75928%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=2mJb7v2GqIErg%2fmOTNGNow&sysid=1)
---
| |
Dear Fellow American, A few years ago, _New York _magazine posed the question: “When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?” This is, of course, an exaggeration. But it makes clear that the far-Left in America aims to bring about a “Great Reset” of our economy and our way of life. In a recent issue of _Imprimis_ --Hillsdale College’s digest of liberty--author Michael Rectenwald described the economic goal of the Great Reset as “‘capitalism with Chinese characteristics’--a two-tiered economy, with profitable monopolies and the state on top and socialism for the majority below.” Today, as a supporter of liberty, you can help Hillsdale College understand the extent of support for--and opposition to--socialism. Your input will help us develop the most effective strategy to fight for the future of liberty in our country. **Will you please share your views on the political, social, and cultural forces promoting socialism in our country by completing your National Survey on Socialism using the secure link below?** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c75929%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=YRdaEd8TBjYiCGfMHhqQ%2fg&sysid=1)** Sadly, socialism is becoming increasingly popular, especially among the young. You may be aware of a SHOCKING survey showing that... **. . . during the COVID-19 pandemic, support for socialism among those 16 to 23 years old jumped to 49 percent, and socialism also increased in popularity among all ages. ** **Why is this?** Draconian government lockdown measures destroyed businesses and eliminated competitors of corporate monopolists. These policies were a dream come true for corporate socialists. At the same time, too many young Americans have not been taught what socialism really means. Or the dismal history of its failures wherever it has been tried. This is a result of the far-Left’s “long march through the institutions”--including colleges and universities, K-12 schools, and the media. Marxist-inspired critical race theory is a prime example. Once confined to the classrooms of far-Left professors, critical race theory has infiltrated every level of government, as well as school boards and even the military. But it is in our schools where the effects of critical race theory--which teaches young Americans to categorize their fellow citizens according to race--are most dangerous. You may recall that many young Americans with college degrees who championed socialist policies participated in the riots and violence we witnessed in the summer of 2020. In the face of well-financed and widespread efforts to destroy free markets and individual liberty, Hillsdale’s work to **reach** and **teach** millions has never been more urgently needed. **That’s why I need your thoughts quickly. ** By responding to the **National Survey on Socialism **in the next five days**, **your honest opinions will help us understand the recent rise of socialism and develop our strategy to **reach** and **teach** increasing millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. We hope to hear from friends representing every part of the country. Education is the surest way to turn back this dangerous trend. And your partnership with Hillsdale College is critical. As Winston Churchill said, “Socialism is the philosophy of failure, the creed of ignorance, and the gospel of envy.” If you agree, please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Socialism** today. **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c75929%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=YRdaEd8TBjYiCGfMHhqQ%2fg&sysid=1)** Despite the recent successes of the far-Left, we must remember--**it is NEVER too late to defend liberty through education**. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---

subject: 87,000 reasons to lower taxes
body:
The Federal government just gave American citizens 87,000 reasons to lower taxes. The Inflation Reduction Act includes funding
[View this message in your browser](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zj8a32n4jhq72sp67dgmef9hud8s36v0ogi24sqo_rp22sh2s8i66or4c3imcor4c1h238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq0sjnm6qb6d9le1oj8cbl6ej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hfao70e4or4tr2ciqn4tlksdpr2oj265o7aolm6th34s7761jb9dtme5gbeolks1jt4s3ic9j71cj6e3ib6or7m9omcdj4mmr3fcjhcoq61cj6c3gbaor0s2qj2cdl66qn49fg)
[](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zofio4aiubk59n7rgsv42cb019ph2d49a7tjncug_rp22sh2s8i66or4c3imcor4c1h2bs)
Friend,

The Federal government just gave American citizens _87,000 reasons to lower taxes._

The Inflation Reduction Act includes funding sufficient for the IRS to hire up to 87,000 employees. What will they be doing?

Unfortunately, we have some troubling clues.

**More than half of the $80 billion the IRS just got in the so-called "Inflation Reduction Act" will go toward _" enforcement activities." _**

Barely 10% will go to "taxpayer services" and "business systems modernization" - two areas in dire need of improvement.

That means however many new hires the IRS makes, the majority of them are likely to fill out an army of auditors, lawyers, data miners, and even criminal investigators. Critical people to answer phones, assist taxpayers in person, and better manage the tax filing seasons will come second.

Let me introduce myself. **My name is Pete Sepp, President of the National Taxpayers Union (NTU).** Our mission is to lobby for practical policy wins that improve the lives of taxpayers.

The Biden administration claims these new agents will only go after large corporations and _ "wealthy tax dodgers."_ **In my 34 years of working on IRS reform issues, I 've seen these kinds of claims before ... **which is why I am worried now for all taxpaying Americans.

It's called the IRS Poverty Cycle.

The IRS pleads poverty. Congress wants "easy revenues" to reduce the deficit without actually cutting wasteful spending, The IRS promises to behave if its budget gets boosted, Congress obliges and then ... things start to go off the rails.

Things start to go off the rails!

Wealthier taxpayers use their resources to fight back, and the tax collections Congress wanted to raise from a bigger IRS budget start to lag. Tactics developed against "the rich" in audits and in courts filter down into the IRS bureaucracy and are eventually used against small businesses and the middle class. Money intended for one purpose gets spent on another, and no one finds out in time to stop it.

[_**NTU is working to end this cycle for good. Can you donate $25, $50, or even $100 to help NTU challenge the IRS? Click here to donate >>>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zd3l931ii3a05drir3d45ltqnuqq9uutp5duosf8_rp22sh2s8i66or4c3imcor4c1h2bs)

Treasury Secretary Yellen has told the IRS Commissioner to avoid auditing middle-income taxpayers and small businesses with this new money, "relative to historic levels." Of course, this directive has plenty of leeway - what if the IRS simply uses existing annual appropriations to target everyday taxpayers instead? The Secretary also wants a detailed plan from the IRS on how they will spend the money - what good is the plan if Congress won't oversee it, which it often fails to do?

**According to the IRS 's own statistics, the most efficient use of IRS funds is to go after low-income taxpayers. It's hard to break a habit like that. **

[](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zj39nn2ng7igapqtd7bnvqqk5dgtsktcru3mut1g_rp22sh2s8i66or4c3imcor4c1h2bs)

If the Biden administration really cared about helping taxpayers, they would simplify the tax code and focus first on improving customer service at the IRS.

But, sadly, that wasn't the motive behind the Inflation Reduction Act. President Biden and his allies wanted to paper over their deficit spending with "cheap and easy" revenue, by beefing up IRS enforcement. It's actually not cheap, nor is it easy. Taxpayers bear the losses, both to their finances and their rights.

[_**But your support helps NTU lobby members of Congress to put sensible safeguards on the powers of the IRS. Please consider donating $25, $50, $100, or any amount today. Click here to give >>>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zhap71m35vv8k18uh88icflkodd3eapf0kgrs6h0_rp22sh2s8i66or4c3imcor4c1h2bs)

**A RECORD OF DEFEATING THE IRS**

Since 1969, NTU has proudly been a major player in signature taxpayer victories of the past five decades.

We were there when President Reagan overhauled the federal tax code. We championed the cause for a "Taxpayer Bill of Rights" and the 2019 Taxpayer First Act. We were also the driving force behind the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act.

We were there in 1998 when we served on the commission that overhauled the IRS. We have experience that no one else has.

**And, for the last two years in a row, NTUF 's Taxpayer Defense Center handed the IRS two unanimous defeats in the Supreme Court!**

The federal government backs the IRS. So who is working for you?

The answer is the National Taxpayers Union.

**Can I count on your support in our mission to defend taxpayers against an overzealous IRS? Click below to donate.**

name: Herschel Walker
subject: Healing, forgiveness and redemption
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TEAM HERSCHEL, INC
body:
|
[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61136615:JYSBEEVIN:m:1:3317145305:8D47DC5968F70D36877D8DBA4A61A888:r)

---
Peter,

In 2008, my former wife, Cindy, and I gave a TV interview to share our story - not about the glory days of football but about the pain of my mental health struggles and their effect on our marriage. It was uncomfortable to bare our souls like that. Mental illness carried more of a stigma back then. It was hard to admit you needed help and _even harder to get it._

Cindy helped me through the hardest time of my life. **Because our story ultimately was one of healing, forgiveness and redemption** , I knew that if we came forward, we could convince others that there is no shame in asking for help. I hoped we would help people who were struggling and maybe even save a few lives.

I think we did. That interview was part of my life's mission to advocate for mental health awareness and treatment. I wrote a book about my experience - every painful detail. **I visited military bases around the world to deliver the message that seeking treatment for post-traumatic stress disorder isn't a sign of weakness but of self-awareness and strength.** I met with youth groups and mental health organizations. I continue to do everything I can to end the stigma. I always say I would much rather listen to a friend talk about his struggles than go to his funeral.

**_I've had a simple message for our troops, veterans, and others struggling with mental health: there's no shame in asking for help. I needed help, and I asked for it._**

But now that I'm running for office, **[my struggle has become the subject of a nasty and dishonest attack ad.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61136615:JYSBEEVIN:m:1:3317145305:8D47DC5968F70D36877D8DBA4A61A888:r)** A group supporting our opponent and funded by Democrats has placed an advertising buy attacking me.

The ad is titled **" The Real Herschel Walker,"** but its producers are the ones hiding something: that I took accountability for my actions and got treatment, that she gave this interview because I asked her to, and that we did this and other interviews together. The ad makers took something designed to do good and turned it into something evil, which will harm innocent people.

[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61136615:JYSBEEVIN:m:1:3317145305:8D47DC5968F70D36877D8DBA4A61A888:r)
Democrats have already spent over $25 million on false attack ads, and that number is growing EACH DAY. Every hour that Democrats attack me without our campaign having the ability to refute their lies with our own ads, we're at a tremendous disadvantage.

**[I need your help to combat their vulgar, gutless attacks against me. Please donate to our media fund right now so we can refute the lies Democrats are peddling and set the record straight.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61136615:JYSBEEVIN:m:1:3317145305:8D47DC5968F70D36877D8DBA4A61A888:r)**

[** DONATE $25 -> **](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61136616:JYSBEEVIN:m:1:3317145305:8D47DC5968F70D36877D8DBA4A61A888:r) [** DONATE $50 -> **](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61136617:JYSBEEVIN:m:1:3317145305:8D47DC5968F70D36877D8DBA4A61A888:r) [** DONATE $75 -> **](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61136618:JYSBEEVIN:m:1:3317145305:8D47DC5968F70D36877D8DBA4A61A888:r) [** DONATE $100 -> **](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61136619:JYSBEEVIN:m:1:3317145305:8D47DC5968F70D36877D8DBA4A61A888:r)
With high gasoline prices, skyrocketing inflation, increasing taxes, and rising crime at the forefront of voters' minds, it's easy to see why my opponents don't want to talk about the issues. They are desperate enough to crawl into the gutter with false attacks against me personally.

**The silver lining of this disgusting attack is that it gives me another opportunity to highlight the importance of mental health awareness and treatment. If you're suffering, know that your life has value. You aren't alone. And I will never stop fighting for you.**

Thanks,

[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61136615:JYSBEEVIN:m:1:3317145305:8D47DC5968F70D36877D8DBA4A61A888:r)

Herschel Walker

clean_body: | Peter, In 2008, my former wife, Cindy, and I gave a TV interview to share our story - not about the glory days of football but about the pain of my mental health struggles and their effect on our marriage. It was uncomfortable to bare our souls like that. Mental illness carried more of a stigma back then. It was hard to admit you needed help and even harder to get it. Cindy helped me through the hardest time of my life. Because our story ultimately was one of healing, forgiveness and redemption , I knew that if we came forward, we could convince others that there is no shame in asking for help. I hoped we would help people who were struggling and maybe even save a few lives. I think we did. That interview was part of my life's mission to advocate for mental health awareness and treatment. I wrote a book about my experience - every painful detail. I visited military bases around the world to deliver the message that seeking treatment for post-traumatic stress disorder isn't a sign of weakness but of self-awareness and strength. I met with youth groups and mental health organizations. I continue to do everything I can to end the stigma. I always say I would much rather listen to a friend talk about his struggles than go to his funeral. I've had a simple message for our troops, veterans, and others struggling with mental health: there's no shame in asking for help. I needed help, and I asked for it. But now that I'm running for office, A group supporting our opponent and funded by Democrats has placed an advertising buy attacking me. The ad is titled " The Real Herschel Walker," but its producers are the ones hiding something: that I took accountability for my actions and got treatment, that she gave this interview because I asked her to, and that we did this and other interviews together. The ad makers took something designed to do good and turned it into something evil, which will harm innocent people. Democrats have already spent over $25 million on false attack ads, and that number is growing EACH DAY. Every hour that Democrats attack me without our campaign having the ability to refute their lies with our own ads, we're at a tremendous disadvantage. With high gasoline prices, skyrocketing inflation, increasing taxes, and rising crime at the forefront of voters' minds, it's easy to see why my opponents don't want to talk about the issues. They are desperate enough to crawl into the gutter with false attacks against me personally. The silver lining of this disgusting attack is that it gives me another opportunity to highlight the importance of mental health awareness and treatment. If you're suffering, know that your life has value. You aren't alone. And I will never stop fighting for you. Thanks, Herschel Walker P.S. body:
You and I are bombarded with bad news every day in the media and in our inbox:
[View this message in your browser](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z8je8l62dt3jviv0qqk826h1vhnn86hhk51oki3o_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgeppef9t56ei3bd9ieir38cth6kpjactmekpradrmeej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hf4p5hmsp7ddtimlj7csdgm1ir1plmm9jbdc72mmpn8o746lim6c34spqb8clle1jt4s3icgr31cj6e9q32tj0s2q6ac70mkom9pj6cooj9cr4c1p3ephksipmcdtgmlin48d245p25oh4cdhm8o75cth68pj24no)
[](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zcsvvrsvpeape8lp3pafh6f8nmnl4cmvtv1cpfu0_rp22sh2s8i66or4c3imeoj4cph2bs)

Friend,

You and I are bombarded with bad news every day in the media and in our inbox:
* Big tech is silencing pro-liberty voices
* Universities are running amok with radical socialists
* The mainstream media openly lies to the public
* Corporate America has embraced Woke propaganda
* Pelosi and her cronies are passing a radical agenda in Congress

Despite all this: _**Yes, there is hope for the future**_.

_What if I told you the thing that gives me the MOST hope are our college students?_ You'd think I was crazy. Aren't they all radicals too?

**Wrong. **

A group of college students is fighting for liberty and may be one of our greatest chances of saving our Republic. Here are a few of their recent victories...
* Helped pass Constitutional Carry in Texas, Indiana, and Alabama!
* Helped expand School Choice in Kentucky, Arizona, and Missouri!
* Adding over 250 hardcore pro-liberty legislators to a national coalition across the country!
* SUED dozens of college campuses and restored free speech rights to over 1.5 million college students!

College students are lining up to defend Constitutional principles and grow a coalition of liberty legislators across the country. Here's how they are doing it.

Allow me to personally introduce Lauren Daugherty. She is the CEO of Young Americans for Liberty (YAL). YAL is the most active and effective pro-liberty youth organization advancing liberty on campus and in American electoral politics.

**Friend, I told Lauren I would help YAL raise $23,000 online. It will go directly towards YAL 's work to fight for laws that advance liberty, train students to become door knockers before the 2022 elections, and so much more. I am asking for your immediate support now to get 1,000 students mobilized for freedom. **

[_**Donate $10 >>**_](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zkmgra9imipg86f6rkkfderpesv6ni5igpm94coo_rp22sh2s8i66or4c3imeoj4cph2bs)

[_**Donate $100 >>**_](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2znthrjvodvb7o2j0q9b53cpqb2rqvfuja9l6ft78_rp22sh2s8i66or4c3imeoj4cph2bs)
[_**Donate $210 to sponsor a student >>**_](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zlq645tcn96dk9mmuua85je7ocgt6hr744cep6ro_rp22sh2s8i66or4c3imeoj4cph2bs)
[_**Donate $420 to sponsor two students >>**_](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zk18e8unfemumknbngs68vgqeev7mkr83qd7q3g0_rp22sh2s8i66or4c3imeoj4cph2bs)
[_**Donate Any Amount >>**_](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z247gf63fgmi37m0sdddc4n00i0pg718a92lfmn8_rp22sh2s8i66or4c3imeoj4cph2bs)

Here's how it works.

> **First:** YAL recruits tens of thousands of students across college campuses. These students start and join an active YAL chapter where they fight back against leftist bias on campus.
>
> **Next:** YAL takes the top student leaders and brings them to top notch trainings. There, students are taught how to transform their campus and fight for liberty candidates and causes in the legislature.
>
> **Then:** Thousands of student activists recruited and trained by YAL knock on doors to push liberty legislation, and turn out the vote for liberty-minded candidates running for office.
>
> **Finally:** These liberty legislators pass bills to defend freedom of speech, protect the 2nd Amendment, and expand free markets.

The results speak volumes of this successful formula to make liberty WIN:

YAL's student activists have helped elect over 250 pro-liberty legislators, repealed 99 unconstitutional free speech codes and regulations, and have started chapters on over 500 college campuses across the country.

All of this hinges on training the next generation of liberty patriots.

Can you join me today to help YAL defend our liberty and train the next generation of liberty activists? Click below to send your urgent support.

[_**Donate $50 >>**_](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zkt5jk3rldahpkv1v5gnp284h5m4qp8g6hocequg_rp22sh2s8i66or4c3imeoj4cph2bs)
[_**Donate $100 >>**_](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zj0o6esrf3lleru4l742idmq48cqebo2nlestv98_rp22sh2s8i66or4c3imeoj4cph2bs)

I’m so sorry. I know I keep reaching out, but I don’t think you understand how serious this is.

|
---
| | | Friend, I’m so sorry. I know I keep reaching out, but I don’t think you understand how serious this is. Just this month, my opponent has:
* Raised more in one month than I was able to all of last quarter
* Launched new attack ads to smear my name and lie about my record
* Gained momentum in multiple polls, which now show our race TIED

---
| | | [STAND WITH MARCO](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c74899%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=hFXFrf%2fo54M8j20UZQ95cA&sysid=1)
---
August has been a total disaster, but these are real goals, real deadlines, and real consequences. If we don’t start making up for lost ground now, we won’t be able to catch up in time for November. **[So I’m humbly asking you to chip in $32.36- our average contribution this month - so we have the resources to fight back against a Pelosi Puppet.](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c74890%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=oUkw244dqRc9JLmthNp9Uw&sysid=1)**

I’m truly grateful for anything you can give, Friend. None of this would be possible without you.

Sincerely,

Marco

**P.S.** In case you missed my most recent message, I’ve attached it for you below:
Friend,

I’m begging you to read every word of this email because what you decide to do next will determine the direction of our country.

Right now, the Biden administration is abusing its power, launching raids against its political opponents and raising your taxes to fund their radical liberal agenda.

August has proven difficult for our campaign. Two polls show us tied, and my opponent is making attack ads lying about my record. On top of this, Democrats are now favored to win the Senate, which means**the Biden administration, Chuck Schumer, and Nancy Pelosi could continue to go unchecked in their pursuit to control every part of your life. **
---
| | | [FIGHT BACK >>](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c74891%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=MeeSX%2feqtiX8kbecP6glHA&sysid=1)
---
FBI raids and high gas prices could become commonplace if we let the Democrats win.

Now, you face two options, and you decide what happens next. 1. You can delete this email, move on with your life, and not be surprised when the Democrats have the full control of the government to abuse. **[2\. I know these messages can seem alarmist, but frankly, I’m alarmed! These are REAL polls, REAL ads, and REAL consequences. Please, chip in $28 so we can stop the Democrats and fight their power-hungry candidates:
---

Thank you,
Marco Rubio

name: Greater Georgia
subject: GREATER GEORGIA ISSUES 18 MONTH FIELD UPDATE, ANNOUNCES OVER 2.2 MILLION VOTER CONTACTS
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Greater Georgia Action, Inc
body:
| | | | |
---
| FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE TUESDAY, AUGUST 30 GREATER GEORGIA ISSUES 18 MONTH FIELD UPDATE, ANNOUNCES OVER 2.2 MILLION VOTER CONTACTS (ATLANTA) - Today, Greater Georgia, the state's conservative voter registration and mobilization group, issued its 18-month field update - announcing over 2.2 million voter contacts since its launch in February 2021. With a statewide network of volunteers and partners, the group is dedicated to growing the conservative movement, by working both in and outside of election years, to engage newly registered voters, disenfranchised and disengaged Georgians, and diverse communities across the state. In addition to hosting dozens of successful registration events, canvassing days, call nights, and ad campaigns, Greater Georgia also helped drive up turnout for the May 2022 midterm primary. Georgia saw a 98% increase in conservative voter turnout and a 152% average increase in minority support for conservative candidates. "From the beginning, Greater Georgia has been committed to investing heavily in the growth of the conservative movement by making inroads with diverse communities and registering new voters," said Greater Georgia Chairwoman Kelly Loeffler. "Over the last 18 months, we've registered tens of thousands of voters, re-engaged thousands more, and built the coalition of voters that have already moved the needle toward greater conservative engagement. I am encouraged by the results of our efforts so far - but our work on the ground continues heading into November."
Overall Field Metrics:
* 2.25 million voter contacts with unregistered, disengaged, and disenfranchised Georgians via text campaigns, digital ad campaigns, television ads, door-to-door canvassing, phone calls, and registration and community events
* Registered tens of thousands of new voters

Record Primary Results: View full memo from the 2022 primary [here](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001iRa8JrL0NSrHV048uhXRyEP-LuYuL-xN_chbXIRVtmymuV3cUFeZk9hhD3OEVwqvmGf43yGnEyhTMxstHNhNmCdNUugpeqgrcZZZCsH2qXBtkE9f-Yp4D-Q54dDgUXL1q0_vJYpuUAykJIDC1W3-inveqt657td9T8V4oeJPMRRqbg-cWaEvAt9J7TX811chWY7SaLQSqg8s-ipGobla3v59qmMxSp3JcBhuMhS_8zgh_jciIruE0PyJP_xSrLNk&c=1eX3T4IJXjFMj2X5hDYx9qtxEU8h0-1SKAANMmxVeU42gbJSPC8YwA==&ch=IIkV1wJpERRgra3ZFDPm_zDWTcReOE-fa9ra7PeN57dEOHyTYUr9Sg==)
* 98% increase in conservative turnout compared to the 2018 midterm primary
* 152% increase in conservative minority turnout
* A majority of Hispanic voters voting conservative for the first time ever
* Over 279,000 new conservative voters who had not voted in any of the last 4 primary elections.

2022 Highlights: Advocacy
* Held the [Atlanta Public School System accountable](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001iRa8JrL0NSrHV048uhXRyEP-LuYuL-xN_chbXIRVtmymuV3cUFeZkxhyw0naqALPEw7AusNlbkc11Ld5PJ-11HEsjG0Vjz7WadbhFS55hSF6qNWFsMTMtPYD4ytddnzBSLP-eABgdBRo7iM2-zf5q0jUIHIAmsDKhQy0_QNOz2VhB-jLWN_9tt7-oVz1CJfGknZ-3rQ63NGi7u7Le_eV8sg10auoIeC398OzVkeMFF8dc7AkKZHCmU14ZzE6xhRO&c=1eX3T4IJXjFMj2X5hDYx9qtxEU8h0-1SKAANMmxVeU42gbJSPC8YwA==&ch=IIkV1wJpERRgra3ZFDPm_zDWTcReOE-fa9ra7PeN57dEOHyTYUr9Sg==) for a civics curriculum and voter registration drives, sponsored in part by liberal activists, that was overtly partisan

* Held three [grocery store voter registration events](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001iRa8JrL0NSrHV048uhXRyEP-LuYuL-xN_chbXIRVtmymuV3cUFeZk-UJnQAFLMT9G6Sc94PVv-VIWrmJxEziT64iwGai1SVk3zHzNNKE4zUFdwb4ymBZ6sGJqoMTbCDi5ISQ3CcDeZTko1DvA8ywlh9QhQ2QBxubjapwqT7gV7Pxv1M3DHl39fmJ04lg2-tldh2dvZDLLk-VHnlymEGUaL10RxDg9QEQ998mwnXCdqczqyn9BoVm0atMwNVGzgRo&c=1eX3T4IJXjFMj2X5hDYx9qtxEU8h0-1SKAANMmxVeU42gbJSPC8YwA==&ch=IIkV1wJpERRgra3ZFDPm_zDWTcReOE-fa9ra7PeN57dEOHyTYUr9Sg==) to engage with consumers affected by record high grocery prices in the metro area

subject: If you read one email today, let this be it
body:
[](http://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=39f2b13f6c554c1f9ae6c5ece456e3f8&_e=BUXjgV9Uz7-hPD4vkOQDVhZC40RjAmY8RgAdfSrFlsnLErDIXp_obR1YBLqJfx-KURmoNzubjdLWVLMmXZMUncHOH9BzwYkxBBfYdtJ6bFx1q5HES-YjI680EYHZ4FdJ4H5pOcZ_MK3r7k8sZJM8Lt-jQziNdn5m-3L1QmGpSJLsLQPdA_42gSo1K1kQ8kNYjEpoKR18wSOzMVCCZ5U3zbqGO6zbHhpAhyusnGA2CUBMb2lzOH52BXRSa1P0bBj7yg1y9CnjyuBhsu-tkHrEbA%3D%3D)

Friend,

You and I are bombarded with bad news every day in the media and in our inbox:
* Big tech is silencing pro-liberty voices
* Universities are running amok with radical socialists
* The mainstream media openly lies to the public
* Corporate America has embraced Woke propaganda
* Pelosi and her cronies are passing a radical agenda in Congress

Despite all this: _**Yes, there is hope for the future**_.

_What if I told you the thing that gives me the MOST hope are our college students?_ You’d think I was crazy. Aren’t they all radicals too?

**Wrong. **

A group of college students is fighting for liberty and may be one of our greatest chances of saving our Republic. Here are a few of their recent victories...
* Helped pass Constitutional Carry in Texas, Indiana, and Alabama!
* Helped expand School Choice in Kentucky, Arizona, and Missouri!
* Adding over 250 hardcore pro-liberty legislators to a national coalition across the country!
* SUED dozens of college campuses and restored free speech rights to over 1.5 million college students!

College students are lining up to defend Constitutional principles and grow a coalition of liberty legislators across the country. Here’s how they are doing it.

subject: Help Mike Close the Border and Protect our Communities...
body:
| | | | | |
---
| | | | Friends, I need your help. The first two years of the Biden presidency have resulted in a catastrophe at our southern border.
* In Biden’s first year in office, The Border Patrol **recorded over 1.8 million migrant apprehensions at the Southern border**.
* This year, encounters at the Southern border are on pace to shatter last year’s number.

---
| | | | The numbers are clear – the Biden Administration’s weak border policies are a threat to our country and our community.
* Since Biden took office, **nearly 18,000 pounds of** fentanyl has been seized at the border, more than twice as much as the previous two years.
* Ohio has suffered more fentanyl deaths, than any other state since 2015.
* In 2021 alone, Ohio experienced the third highest number of fentanyl deaths.

---
| | | | | [Support Mike Here! Close the Border, Protect our Communities!](https://click.icptrack.com/icp/relay.php?r=126057447&msgid=1015421&act=NE1B&c=493811&pid=12544060&destination=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.winred.com%2Fturner%2Fsupport-mike-turner&cf=64880&v=a9bc398e9f07d9ae65eac8dfeb29126d428ae43df52345c5c3fbf5aec4fa5284)

---
Peter,

I’ve been given an ultimatum.

body:
Friend, I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zl82ke6pk60tbi8u89k25j0gin3e44kg5ljm5598_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jkgqracjkmoq37d1m65qbfctjmkrncst66uqrf91ieoob9crl6uie5sj2u1oj0t73e1or0sb4mhimeo3mcmrbasllesqj6sjmcdhj5ddlcooj8o9j64oj7dtnq9o74oj6e2p6cs74mdhmfcjhcor65ddk6upb4phgm2p6co70mlhm1o5l64oracdle8gq48bi4bh28or3chgeepb2c9i649fg)

| | | Friend,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $5 makes a difference. $5 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zar6qd4otgnejgn292rc46va6rge06gvt0t71pc0_rp22sh2s8i66or4c3jmaoj2chh2bs "Johnson1")**_

Please, Friend, our future is counting on our actions today.

Thanks for reading this email. I appreciate you and your family.

Thank you for your support,
Ron

body:
I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c920805%7c6905%7c7%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c0&wdmdk=5ONn0rTRlItuybGWEAPIGw&sysid=1)

|
---
| | | Friend,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $5 makes a difference. $5 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c74815%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=7a%2fguHmgU1z6pkbKX%2fmjlw&sysid=1 "Johnson1")**_

Please, Friend, our future is counting on our actions today.

Thanks for reading this email. I appreciate you and your family.

Thank you for your support,
Ron

---

Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $5 makes a difference. $5 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z4ojv0j6mqoeksek3mhq5lnd32bdiaj922resuq8_rp22sh2s8i66or4c3jmao71c5h2bs "Johnson1")**_

Please, Friend, our future is counting on our actions today.

Thanks for reading this email. I appreciate you and your family.

Thank you for your support,
Ron

About 30 years ago, I was a little younger, a little less gray, and was a young lieutenant.

_**My tank was Bravo 21.**_ My gunner was a young man named Sayed - the best gunner in our platoon.

We were preparing to fight the Soviets during the Cold War and had just finished a training run.

**Remarkably, we had just hit two consecutive moving targets at a distance of little more than a mile. **

After accomplishing this remarkable feat, Sayed turned to me and said "Lieutenant, America is awesome".

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c612934%7c6384%7c6%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c1&wdmdk=xinDjKsNa7UbmNdqQlRViQ&sysid=1)

| | | Friend,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $5 makes a difference. $5 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c75922%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=unQKwrA0hJjjeTvMpwTppQ&sysid=1 "Johnson1")**_

Please, Friend, our future is counting on our actions today.

Thanks for reading this email. I appreciate you and your family.

Thank you for your support,
Ron

name: Donna Rice Hughes, Enough is Enough
subject: Stop online exploitation of children
body:
| | Please see a special message from our sponsor.
---
| | | | [](http://trk.patriotmarketplace.)
---
Dear Friend, When children go online, they have direct and immediate access to friends, family, and complete strangers, which can put unsuspecting minors at great risk. **Children who meet and communicate with strangers online are easy prey for internet predators and traffickers who rely on anonymous access to children online, can conceal their identity, roam without limit and avoid law enforcement detection. ** Vulnerable and unsuspecting children, who can fall into the predator's grooming trap, are often seduced into sending sexual images of themselves. Online grooming is one of the many tactics used by predators to create child sex abuse material (CSAM), also known as child pornography. Their suffering is not a one-time crime. Instead, any time the depiction of their abuse is sold, shared, bartered or used privately for a consumer's sexual gratification, the crime against the victim is repeated. Sadly, millions of children and families have suffered due to greed for profit by interactive technology companies. Instead of protecting children, they knowingly allowed them to be abused and exploited on their platforms! There needs to be a dramatic paradigm shift regarding Big Tech's response to child online sexual exploitation for the internet to be safer for children. They must become a more vital part of the solution, rather than a HUGE part of the problem. Our team at Enough Is Enough (EIE) has been on the front lines in the fight to protect children and families online since 1994 - _Now, the threat is greater than ever, so we must significantly increase our efforts, but we cannot do it without your support._ **We** '**re taking on Big Tech and Social Media giants to demand protection for children online, and to make sure these corporations are held accountable, but we need parents and concerned citizens across America to stand alongside us to make our voices heard.** And we're making waves! But we're not done yet. On February 10th of this year, the Senate Judiciary Committee unanimously voted to pass the _ _**_EARN IT Act of 2022_** (S. 3538) out of committee and onto a full vote in the Senate and is pending in the Senate and the House of Representatives! If enacted, The EARN IT Act will remove blanket immunity for social media and technology companies that knowingly facilitate the distribution of CSAM on its platforms. This priority bill also gives victims of CSAM the chance to restore their privacy and confront those who facilitate this crime against them.
---
[](http://trk.patriotmarketplace.)
---
We need the voices of our supporters like you to be heard loud and clear! We need this critical piece of bi-partisan legislation to be passed immediately and will advocate for other Senators to sign on, and champion a call for its passage in the House! [**To help rein in Big Tech and STOP the online sexual exploitation of children, please make an urgent donation of $10, $25, $50, $100, $250, $500 or more today.**](http://trk.patriotmarketplace.-d8CE-5EQDg)
---
[**I Want To End Online Child Exploitation**](http://trk.patriotmarketplace.-yatubEA)
---
Often, we have an image of sexual predators and traffickers lurking around school playgrounds or hiding behind bushes scoping out their potential victims. **But Friend, the reality is that today** '**s sexual predators search for victims while hiding behind a computer screen, taking advantage of the anonymity the internet offers. ** With your support, EIE will continue to advocate for the aggressive enforcement of existing federal laws to prevent the sexual exploitation of children online, including the obscenity, child pornography, sexual predation & sex trafficking laws. _We are advocating for Congress to close loopholes in current laws, as EARN It does, and end blanket immunity for corporations that knowingly allow children to be exploited or sold for sex on their platforms, but we cannot achieve this goal without your generous support._ [**Please make a generous donation of $10, $25, $50, $100, $250, $500 or more right away to help rein in Big Tech and end the online exploitation of children.**](http://trk.patriotmarketplace.-Wc5YEe0BrO6QAOSrg)
---
[**I Want To End Online Child Exploitation**](http://trk.patriotmarketplace.-PbcQDN7_PKap0LBPHgNg)
---
People who do not believe that their children could ever become victimized online are living in an unrealistic world. _Every child has the potential to become victimized - and potentially suffer a lifetime of re-victimization -- through online technologies, but EIE is here to put an end to harmful internet exploitation with your help. _ Friend,**** It is very important for parents and concerned community members like you to be well informed of the risks children face online and take needed action before the threat becomes too great to quell. [**Please make your gift-worthy contribution today.**](http://trk.patriotmarketplace.) Thank You,
---
Donna Rice HughesPresident / CEOEnough Is Enough

subject: As Attorney General, Adam Laxalt was yet another Republican man who constantly used his office to attack abortion rights … including supporting the Texas law allowing men to collect bounties for turning in women for seeking an abortion. Don’t let this insurrectionist beat out Catherine Cortez Masto.
body:
Can we keep the Senate?
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
| |
---
| | | | | Peter, **_Another coup supporter may flip a Senate seat, and with it the entire U.S. Senate, and we MUST stop him._** Adam Laxalt, right wing former Attorney General of Nevada and current GOP U.S. Senate nominee, is a special kind of danger. **He's a Trump-supported liar who says the election was stolen in 2020. As Attorney General, he was yet another Republican man who constantly used his office to attack abortion rights. Not satisfied with just trying to make women second class citizens in Nevada, he signed onto amicus briefs in at least four other states--including the Texas law allowing men to collect bounties for turning in women--attacking a woman's right to choose.** Laxalt stood with the NRA on gun laws, opposed a multistate effort to make Exxon pay for lying about their knowledge of climate change and joined a California lawsuit to specifically help the Koch Brothers, one of his biggest donors, who rewarded him by spending $2.5 million on his campaign. **[We simply can't afford to risk all that's at stake here. Can you please join us at Blue Amp Action by giving $2, $5, $10 or whatever you can afford to a woman we can be proud of and count on, Senator Catherine Cortez Masto?](https://default.salsalabs.org/T82843424-b74c-4253-995c-8d4654648428/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** He is awful, but in a close swing state that Joe Biden only won by 2 points, Laxalt benefits from his last name, as his grandfather was a very popular Governor and Senator, and that and his strong support from Trump and Ron DeSantis, who will both be holding rallies there for him, as well as $18 million in attack ads by Mitch McConnell will make this a nail biter.

| | | Peter - This is Dr. Oz.

Instead of focusing on the price of gas, food, and other essentials, Biden and the Democrats are far more concerned about transgender athletes and the Green New Deal.

**NOW** , we're hearing that my leftist opponent, John Fetterman, thinks the administration hasn't gone far enough!

We can't allow John Fetterman to double down on Biden's failed agenda and lead us further down the road to socialism. That's why I'm coming to you for help.
