I'm not afraid of a few leftist agitators, Peter. But I could really use your help in what's shaping up to be the #1 Senate race in the nation.

Thank you for your time,
Dr. Oz

body:
I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zoklf8uhntk35ea38dlftisbag4vl0dj1ppudqro_rp22sh2s8i66or4c3jmeo36cth238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq9dhkumqb7d9neppqcdtlmui34thgmipnadt4sbp65tr3mgorcdjnm1hn6ornm3gn6t3le9pr9p5i64oradb4sji6ac70stgr5d5k66rjfkjge9h6cs5icpoe9cr3cup72phmcaqradtmcdj32s5icpge1db3c3gbac9hmkorash5u)

|
---
| | | Friend,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $5 makes a difference. $5 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2za2q6oqsd44e8kla46sua448gdoepj1tlherkse0_rp22sh2s8i66or4c3jmeo36cth2bs "Johnson1")**_

Please, Friend, our future is counting on our actions today.

Thanks for reading this email. I appreciate you and your family.

Thank you for your support,
Ron

As I have told crowds since my first Tea Party speeches: this is a fight for freedom. **This is not someone else 's fight, this is our fight, and it's a fight we absolutely must win.** As a grandpa, dad, and businessman, I refuse to lose our country to radicals and woke liberals with their socialist agenda. I refuse to jeopardize America's future. I know you feel the same.

_**[**Can I personally ask you to join me in this fight for Freedom, Friend?**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zpfcs3jv69rsjmi83vfdidk0ugpaop8b2hidklt0_rp22sh2s8i66or4c3jmeo36cth2bs "Can I personally ask you to join me in this fight for Freedom, Friend?")**_

subject: ***Immediate Release*** Join Governor Youngkin and Me for Official Signing my Bill HB1128 to Reduce Taxes all Retired Veterans
disclaimer_text: Paid for and Authorized by Friends of John McGuire
body:
With Delegate John McGuire
| | | | |
VA Delegate John McGuire
(Father - Navy SEAL - Business Owner) Running for VA State Senate District 10 in 2023
---
| Fellow Virginians, Please join Governor Youngkin, fellow veterans, fellow legislators, and me for the Ceremonial Signing for my bipartisan bill to reduce taxes on Veteran Retirement Pay up to $40k HB 1128 and the Senate version SB 528. This is the largest veteran tax decrease in Virginia history.
Success: For 30 years the General Assembly has worked on similar legislation with no result. Thank you Governor Youngkin, fellow legislators, and everyone else who helped us get this done. It really is amazing what we can achieve when we work as a team!
Signing ceremony:
When: Sept 9 at 9 AM
Where: Patricio Enterprises, Inc.525 Corporate Dr, Suite 201, Stafford, VA 22554
RSVP: by Sept 6 via email to john@mcguireforvirginia.com
Put "Veteran" in subject line.
We conformed my $40k veteran tax reduction House Bill 1128 with no age requirement to the $15k veteran tax reduction Senate Bill 528 with an age requirement. The final compromise version between the House and the Senate will reduce taxes for veteran retirement pay up to $40k starting at age 55.
For too long Virginia veterans have retired to other states to avoid retirement pay taxes. This bill sends a message to Virginia veterans saying we appreciate your service and we want you to stay.
Bill details:
If you receive any of the following benefits, and are age 55 or older, here are the individual income tax subtractions you can claim:
\- Military benefits paid out to the surviving spouse of a service member \- Benefits paid out under the DOD's Survivor Benefits Program \- "Certain military benefits" as defined in the IRS Code (Any allowance or in-kind benefit, not including personal use of a vehicle, that is received by a service member or dependent)

* Up to $10,000 for FY2022
* Up to $20,000 for FY2023
* Up to $30,000 for FY2024
* Up to $40,000 for FY2025, and beyond

---
| I'm running for State Senate District 10 in 2023 so we can un-California Virginia. It starts with election integrity. Take care, please spread the word and I look forward to seeing you around the district!
---

body:
Chipping in today is so important to defending our Senate majority this November.
#
Hi Derek, it’s Jaime Harrison, Chair of the Democratic National Committee.
In just a moment, I’m going to ask you to **[make a $5 donation to my friend John Fetterman’s Senate campaign.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220830-1?refcode=em20220830-7026&refcode2=7026_434096_RkCMlj&akid=7026%2E434096%2ERkCMlj)** But before I do, I hope you’ll give me a moment to explain why chipping in today is so important to defending our Democratic Senate majority this November.
I’ve long said that any state can be a blue state if we invest the talent, time, and resources.
**We’ve certainly got the talent — I mean, have you _seen_ John?**
We’re running short on how much time we have left. Pennsylvanians will start voting in just a few weeks!
That makes resources our X-factor. John is setting out to win Every County, Every Vote — but this work is as expensive as it is critical. We can’t leave anything to chance, and your contribution today will go a long way toward sending Dr. Oz packing back home to New Jersey.
[**Can you make a donation of $5 (or whatever you can afford) ahead of Wednesday’s end-of-month deadline so we can flip this seat and defend our Democratic majority in the U.S. Senate?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220830-1?refcode=em20220830-7026&refcode2=7026_434096_RkCMlj&akid=7026%2E434096%2ERkCMlj)

# California’s Schiff To Host Pappas Fundraiser in Boston
By: Fred Lucas
[NH Journal](https://mattmowers.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0b9f631aa1029b60ed9a5731f&id=57c62ab2be&e=ee27ab5035)
---
| One of the most prominent figures from the Democrats’ dogged attempts to push the now-debunked Russia collusion story is coming to New England to raise money for Rep. Chris Pappas. And perhaps pick up support for a leadership post in his party. House Intelligence Committee Chairman Adam Schiff has made no secret he is hoping to move up within his party’s caucus, perhaps even taking Speaker Nancy Pelosi’s place. The California Democrat will be in Boston Tuesday to fundraise for Pappas and Rep. Jared Golden of Maine. Both are in districts rated “toss-ups” in the midterm election. Matt Mowers, one of the Republicans running in the NHGOP primary to take on Pappas, calls Schiff “one of the most divisive members of Congress in the country.” _**“As Nancy Pelosi pours millions of dollars into the race, it’s clear that Pappas needs more help from California to keep his failing campaign afloat.”**_ The Washington Post [first reported](https://mattmowers.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0b9f631aa1029b60ed9a5731f&id=1e1892561e&e=ee27ab5035) Schiff is making a push to be House Democratic leader should current Pelosi step aside from the top spot after the midterms. Should things go better than expected for Democrats in the fall, he could be vying for speaker. Schiff has outraised his potential competitors to lead the Democrat caucus, Rep. Hakeem Jeffries of New York, House Majority Leader Steny Hoyer of Maryland, and Majority Whip James Clyburn of South Carolina, according to [Open Secrets](https://mattmowers.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0b9f631aa1029b60ed9a5731f&id=0f2908aa0b&e=ee27ab5035), which tracks money in politics. He hauled in $16.9 million for his campaign and his Frontline USA PAC raised $1.7 million. The Jeffries campaign raised $4.4 million, the Hoyer campaign raised $3 million, and the Clyburn campaign raised $2.7 million. None of those members have competitive races, but the money haul can indicate their strength within the party and their capacity to help the campaigns of colleagues. Schiff is perhaps the member of Congress most identified with promoting the Trump-Russia collusion narrative that dominated D.C. for the first two years of the Trump presidency. Schiff, serving as ranking member of the House Intelligence Committee, consistently suggested he was privy to evidence the public was not. He told NBC’s Meet the Press host Chuck Todd in April 2017, “I would characterize it this way at the outset of the investigation: There is circumstantial evidence of collusion. There is direct evidence, I think, of deception and that’s where we begin the investigation.” Less than a month later, Schiff engaged in a conversation that he will likely never live down. The Russian comedy team, Vladimir Kuznetsov and Alexey Stolyarov pranked him as one claiming to be a Ukraine politician Andriy Parubiy [informed](https://mattmowers.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0b9f631aa1029b60ed9a5731f&id=4901a07e6d&e=ee27ab5035) Schiff, “There were pictures of naked Trump.” Schiff replied, “And so Putin was made aware of the availability of the compromising material?” The fake Parubiy said it was the means for blackmail. The Daily Mail [reported](https://mattmowers.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0b9f631aa1029b60ed9a5731f&id=edab105406&e=ee27ab5035) Schiff’s staff continuously followed up to try to collect the “classified materials for the FBI” from a likely bewildered Ukraine embassy in Washington. Schiff was later named chairman of the House Intelligence Committee by his fellow Democrats. After the Mueller report was released finding no evidence of collusion and contradicting Schiff’s public claims of “proof,” one expert on the Russia case [labeled him](https://mattmowers.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0b9f631aa1029b60ed9a5731f&id=72366de7c8&e=ee27ab5035) “the boy who cried ‘collusion.'” GOP members of the Intel Committee responded by [calling on Schiff to resign](https://mattmowers.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0b9f631aa1029b60ed9a5731f&id=e1a7ecce80&e=ee27ab5035). “Your willingness to continue to promote a demonstrably false narrative is alarming,” the committee members wrote. “The findings of the special counsel conclusively refute your past and present assertions and have exposed you as having abused your position to knowingly promote false information, having damaged the integrity of this Committee, and undermined faith in U.S. government institutions.” Schiff [continues to insist](https://mattmowers.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0b9f631aa1029b60ed9a5731f&id=8b2becbb35&e=ee27ab5035) the collusion story is true.

When the Russia scandal did not work for Democrats, Schiff promptly took leadership of the Democratic House’s impeachment of Trump over a phone call between Trump and Ukraine President Volodymyr Zelenskyy. Schiff was caught lying about communications between his staff and the whistleblower on the Trump-Zelensky call. Schiff claimed it never happened, until [The New York Times reported](https://mattmowers.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0b9f631aa1029b60ed9a5731f&id=ebb5d89de0&e=ee27ab5035) that it did. While leading the Ukraine impeachment probe, Schiff’s staff gathered phone records from AT&T and Verizon of Trump’s allies — and at least one journalist — without using the subpoena process. He also failed to notify the targets. Wall Street Journal _ _ columnist Kimberly Strassel referred to this as Schiff’s “[surveillance state](https://mattmowers.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0b9f631aa1029b60ed9a5731f&id=91c6d155aa&e=ee27ab5035).” In March 2020, Federal Communications Commission Commissioner Brendan Carr wrote in a letter to Schiff that Congress has the right to seek information but not without judicial review. Under Schiff’s leadership, Carr wrote, “The committee created out of whole cloth a secret and effectively unreviewable and unchecked mechanism for obtaining call records on any and all Americans.” _**“In New Hampshire, Chris Pappas acts like JFK, but in Washington, he votes like AOC. Pappas’ voting record shows that he will do anything to please the far-left and kiss Nancy Pelosi’s ring,” Mowers said. “From lying about intelligence reports, sham hearings, and his multiple attempts to divide our country for political power, Adam Schiff is one of the most corrupt members of Congress in the country.**_ _**“While Pappas, Schiff, and their Harvard buddies drink tea and eat crumpets in Boston tomorrow, I’ll be meeting Granite Staters who are trying to figure out if they’ll be able to heat their home this winter.”**_

We hope you’ll take it as a sign of how important these requests are to our work.
#

Friends -
We’ve sent a few emails asking for donations ahead of tomorrow’s August fundraising deadline, and we hope you’ll take it as a sign of how important these requests are to our work.
Let us explain:
The truth is, almost all of the donations Giffords PAC receives come from lots and lots of people chipping in small amounts of money. And there is no greater source of those donations than emails like this one.
The money we raise funds our work convincing Congress to act on gun safety, like the bill we just passed.
That money goes toward running ads to elect members of Congress who will act on gun safety.
And that money goes toward winning gun safety laws at the local level, as well as stopping efforts by the gun lobby to weaken our laws.
None of that would be possible without donations like the one we are asking you to make today. None of that would be possible without emails like this one.
So please:

body:
| | | Peter, The end-of-month deadline is a HUGE milestone for every Senator, Congressman, and candidate.
I wanted to share where we are with my most loyal grassroots conservatives, and that includes you.
_Not everyone made the cut to get this update, so please do not share this email with anyone else._
**Right now, we still need to raise $10,284 more if we’re going to meet our end-of-month goal by TOMORROW at midnight.**

This is alarming, but I need you to read:
**Don Bolduc, a far-right extremist running against me, is leading the polls in New Hampshire.**
This isn't just bad news for our Senate majority – it's bad for our democracy.
Bolduc continues to push the Big Lie and baseless election fraud claims and even “promised to defy the presidential election results, should he be called upon to do so in 2024."
And that’s not all—Bolduc says he is open to abolishing the FBI and even recently called to repeal the 17th Amendment, which allows voters to elect their Senators directly.
Don Bolduc's dangerous rhetoric couldn't be more out of touch with Granite State values, and if elected, he would only drag New Hampshire backward.
With everything from reproductive rights (Bolduc said we should “rejoice” at _Roe_ being overturned) to the fate of our planet (he said climate is “not a priority”) on the line, we cannot afford to have Don Bolduc in the United States Senate.
That's why I'm reaching out to you today, team. Defending this seat and our Senate majority is the only way we can stop Mitch McConnell and extreme Republicans like Bolduc from enacting their far-right agenda.

Peter,

I don't have good news today...

**Recent polling shows my Democrat opponent, Raphael Warnock, leading by 3 points.** For months we've been in a dead heat, but now I'm slightly behind in Georgia's crucial Senate showdown.

This is a significant setback for Republicans everywhere.

I wish that was the only piece of bad news I had for you today, but it's not...

My Democrat opponent is the _leading _fundraiser in the entire country. He's raising record amounts of money in record time. The latest report shows he raised $17 MILLION in the last 3 MONTHS. If I'm going to catch up, I need MAJOR reinforcements, which is why I'm reaching out to you today, Peter. _**[I need you to rush an emergency contribution of ANY AMOUNT to help us close the fundraising gap.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61144578:67YvaEVNd:m:1:3253819041:E0522CB2D01B5240E05D281225B7D4FE:r "It’s important that we band
together and show the Democrats that we’re willing to do whatever it takes to pull off a win.")**_

There's too much at stake to sit on the sidelines. _Georgia is in danger. Our Senate majority is in danger. The future of our country is in danger._

Democrat Super PACs and my opponent have already spent $25 million in false attack ads against me, which is why we've lost ground in the polls. _Unfortunately, we haven't had the money to respond or set the record straight._

This is just the beginning... Democrats are already scheming on how to spend another $25 MILLION. _**[They MUST be STOPPED.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61144578:67YvaEVNd:m:1:3253819041:E0522CB2D01B5240E05D281225B7D4FE:r "It’s
important that we band together and show the Democrats that we’re willing to do whatever it takes to pull off a win.")**_

It's clear that they see me as a threat. The fate of the Senate majority will be determined by the outcome of our race in Georgia. That's why we must fully fund our ads and grassroots efforts to make sure Georgians learn the truth about Raphael Warnock's far-left record.

_**[Peter, I need your help now more than ever. If you're able, would you please contribute $25 or more to help us close the fundraising gap? Every penny counts, and your help is CRITICAL.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61144578:67YvaEVNd:m:1:3253819041:E0522CB2D01B5240E05D281225B7D4FE:r "It’s important that we band together and show the Democrats that we’re willing to do whatever it
takes to pull off a win.")**_

Thank you for your support.

Onward to victory,

Herschel Walker
Republican for U.S. Senate

Our topic is Defending Our Freedoms; Delivering Our Future. Congressman Neguse is a member of House Leadership, elected by his peers, and a Co-Chair of the Democratic Policy and Communications Committee (DPCC.) He serves on the House Judiciary Committee, on the House Natural Resources Committee, and on the House Select Committee on the Climate Crisis.

From his Eritrean American immigrant parents, Congressman Neguse learned the value of being an engaged and informed citizen and of serving one’s community. Taking their values to heart, Congressman Neguse is a fierce patriot who defends our freedoms and Democracy every day – and did so on the national stage as an Impeachment Manager last year.

Rep. Neguse works for solutions to heal our planet and to create opportunity for his constituents in Colorado’s 2nd District and for all Americans. He fights for fair elections and voting rights and to bring the American Dream, that his family has lived, closer in reach for all of America’s working families.

Join our conversation! We’re talking about House Democrats delivering historic climate action, lower health costs, health care for our veterans, good-paying green jobs, investments in technology and our future and defending our freedoms and Democracy.

Thank you for your support. None of these accomplishments would be possible without the engagement of our VIPS – you, our volunteers in politics and policy – who fuel all of our wins For The People.
Thank you,
NANCY

clean_body: It’s critical that we protect and expand our majorities in this year’s midterm elections. | | Derek -- When I accepted the Democratic Party’s nomination for vice president two years ago this month, I spoke about a vision of our nation where all are welcome -- no matter what we look like, where we come from, or who we love. It’s the vision that made my own life possible. The vision that makes the American promise -- for all its complexities and imperfections -- a promise worth fighting for. And it’s the vision that Democrats are working toward every day. But with incredibly slim congressional majorities and exactly 70 days until the midterm elections, we must redouble our efforts and elect Democrats up and down the ballot to continue pursuing that promise. Can I count on you to make your first $7 donation of the year ahead of our party’s critical end-of-month deadline? All of the progress that we’ve made so far -- historic investments in our roads and bridges, lowering costs for workers and families, action on gun violence, and more -- was made possible thanks to the Democratic majorities that supporters like you helped elect. But the simple truth is that if we don’t keep investing in the future success of our party now, we could risk losing our congressional majorities and threatening all of the progress we’ve made so far. So I’m asking: Thank you for all that you do, Kamala Kamala Harris Vice President of the United States Kamala Harris: Derivative of Adam Schultz / Biden for President Photo. Dear PragerU Supporter, The world seems to get crazier every day. More than ever, we need to stick together and help each other. That’s our philosophy at PragerU. We continue our work come hell (CRT propaganda, the sexualization of our children) or high water (inflation, recession, or stagflation). If you have seen any PragerU videos, you know we provide much needed common sense content to millions of people 24/7. [**August is PragerU's fundraising month and from now until August 31, generous PragerU donors have committed to tripling all donations --thereby TRIPLING YOUR GIFT!**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c32862%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=p1Ia%2fc02ZiwxwQ1sSZzS2w&sysid=1) With inflation and economic uncertainty, many people are not able to give as much as before. But if you give today, your 100% tax-deductible donation will go 3X further and have TRIPLE THE IMPACT. The PragerU team is more committed and working harder than ever to educate young people about our nation’s founding principles and values. Those values have sustained America through hard times. They will do so again.
---
[Donate Now](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c32863%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=EGMel7cUmzgVDQSJNwCmwg&sysid=1)
---
But dark clouds are gathering. We've been getting troubling emails from some of our most dedicated online supporters. Because of the economic downturn, some are saying that they will not be able to help us with a donation this year. Sky high gas prices and bigger grocery bills are overwhelming them. Some have even lost their jobs. **About 40% of PragerU’s donations come from individual, online donors, so it makes perfect sense we are tracking behind our budgeted goal. But, this is not the time to scale back our efforts. This is the time to scale up! We need your help to fill this gap.** [Can we count on your tax-deductible support today to help us continue being your voice and fighting for everything you care about? Your gift today will be TRIPLED and have TRIPLE THE IMPACT.](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c32864%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=mZ%2fJUcELfgOWrDSKDnS9LA&sysid=1) In the midst of this terrible uncertainty lies an opportunity to educate Americans, who are spending more time online than ever before, about our shared ideas and values. The better-funded left will use this opportunity to diminish our voice. They are working together right now to find the money to bury our ideas--simply by rapidly investing in their ideology far more than we do. [Thanks to the generous PragerU donors funding this 3X matching campaign, your gift will now have TRIPLE THE IMPACT!](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c32875%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=dyag%2bSO%2bqLrmRFrDlqbs4w&sysid=1) **That means your $50 gift to PragerU turns into $150. Your $250 gift turns into $750. If you give $1,000 to PragerU, your impact explodes to $3,000 in funding to change millions of young minds --and millions of young lives--for the better.**

body:
We need everyone off the sidelines

Defenders of democracy, as Attorney General, I made sure every vote was counted. The former president and his enablers sued my office **43 times.** In fact, they sued my office **19 times** before a _single vote was counted_ — just to try and make it harder for Black and brown folks to vote.
Now I’m running for governor against Doug Mastriano — who has vowed to succeed where those lawsuits failed, destroy our democracy, and overturn the 2024 election if he doesn’t like the winner. He even attended the insurrection.
If we are going to win these battles to defend our democracy, it requires everyone to get off the sidelines, get in the game, and do our part. We need you now more than ever to make sure every voice is heard. **The New Pennsylvania Project** isn’t out there for one candidate or another — they’re out there fighting for democracy itself. **_[So I am asking you, can you fight for democracy right now by giving $25?_Every dollar counts_.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/49994770/364207907/-632654605?refcode=EM_FR_220830Shapiro_N_JS_FULL_5_NG_N_L1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVjAwMS8xLzkwOTIwIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImE3ZTVmNzhhLTlhMjgtZWQxMS1hZTgzLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=6fTDoKsY7sEo6ujikWxBBR6oc8BpUb6EAaNRejRWxIQ=)_**
I’m supporting the **New Pennsylvania Project** because expanding the electorate is hard but crucial work. Seriously, I can’t overstate how **unbelievably important** their work is to the defense of our democracy. Because they get to stick around after November, they can build trust and put in the sustained work across elections to make real change happen. And knowing they’re out there every day gives me both peace of mind and the freedom to focus my efforts on talking policy and persuading voters.

subject: You're Invited- Historic Bill Signing with Governor Youngkin 🇺🇸
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY FRIENDS OF BRYCE REEVES
body:

| | |
---
| | [](https://f1v3ff69.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fbrycereeves.com/1/01000182ef6528bb-3ee93823-395a-4b42-9ef9-22b9ab7375ef-000000/UQw8ypVA10q8hWZp1TiO0QuAdgk=285)
---
| Dear friends, After many years and multiple attempts, I have finally secured the largest tax cut ever given to our veterans in Virginia. I am grateful to all of my colleagues on both sides of the aisle for putting veterans first. Too long have we ignored some of our most dedicated patriots in Virginia. I am proud to announce that on Friday, September 9th, I will join Governor Youngkin in Stafford County to sign my bill SB528 into law that will cut taxes on military retiree pay to the tune of hundreds of millions of dollars over the next few years, culminating in our veterans being able to claim up to $40,000 of personal income tax deductions in FY2025 and every year beyond.
---
| | |
---
| If you would like to join us, please feel free. If you have a friend, family member, or neighbor who served or actively serves in our armed forces, please extend the invitation to them as well. If you aren't in the military or retired from military service, but would like to come out to support our Commonwealth's veterans, please do so! Just be sure to RSVP to my staff member, James at james@brycereeves.com if you plan on attending. The details are as follows: Friday, September 9, 9:00 AM at Patricio Enterprises, Inc.525 Corporate DriveStafford, VA 22554
---
| | |
---
| I hope to see you there! It's a good opportunity to support Virginia's thriving military community and to say hello to our Governor. Just remember to RSVP to **james@brycereeves.com** , and I'll see you on Friday, Sept. 9th! Yours in service,
---
| | |
---
| Bryce E. ReevesSenator17th Senatorial District of VA(540) 645-8440

body:

subject: Peter, I don't have good news today...

body:
| |
---
| | |
Peter,

I don't have good news today...

**Recent polling shows my Democrat opponent, Raphael Warnock, leading by 3 points.** For months we've been in a dead heat, but now I'm slightly behind in Georgia's crucial Senate showdown.

This is a significant setback for Republicans everywhere.

I wish that was the only piece of bad news I had for you today, but it's not...

My Democrat opponent is the _leading _fundraiser in the entire country. He's raising record amounts of money in record time. The latest report shows he raised $17 MILLION in the last 3 MONTHS. If I'm going to catch up, I need MAJOR reinforcements, which is why I'm reaching out to you today, Peter. _**[I need you to rush an emergency contribution of ANY AMOUNT to help us close the fundraising gap.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61144627:6lBTzEVNh:m:1:3317145305:BF9C6BBB293ACA281FE1AF4B50BAA297:r "It’s important that we band together and show the Democrats that we’re
willing to do whatever it takes to pull off a win.")**_

There's too much at stake to sit on the sidelines. _Georgia is in danger. Our Senate majority is in danger. The future of our country is in danger._

Democrat Super PACs and my opponent have already spent $25 million in false attack ads against me, which is why we've lost ground in the polls. _Unfortunately, we haven't had the money to respond or set the record straight._

This is just the beginning... Democrats are already scheming on how to spend another $25 MILLION. _**[They MUST be STOPPED.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61144627:6lBTzEVNh:m:1:3317145305:BF9C6BBB293ACA281FE1AF4B50BAA297:r "It’s important that
we band together and show the Democrats that we’re willing to do whatever it takes to pull off a win.")**_

It's clear that they see me as a threat. The fate of the Senate majority will be determined by the outcome of our race in Georgia. That's why we must fully fund our ads and grassroots efforts to make sure Georgians learn the truth about Raphael Warnock's far-left record.

_**[Peter I need your help now more than ever. If you're able, would you please contribute $25 or more to help us close the fundraising gap? Every penny counts, and your help is CRITICAL.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61144627:6lBTzEVNh:m:1:3317145305:BF9C6BBB293ACA281FE1AF4B50BAA297:r "It’s important that we band together and show the Democrats that we’re willing to do
whatever it takes to pull off a win.")**_

Thank you for your support.

Onward to victory,

Herschel Walker
Republican for U.S. Senate

There is simply no other way to put it: GOP extremists are taking control over women's reproductive decisions and bodies across the country. And if the Republican Party has its way, this is only the beginning. They will not stop until a national abortion ban is passed through Congress. **We can stop them – and save reproductive choice – by electing pro-choice women like Val Demings. **
Not only will this race in Florida decide Senate control, Val Demings has pledged to abolish the filibuster so we can enshrine abortion rights into federal law. Her opponent, Marco Rubio, on the other hand, is a man who has fought for governmental control of women's bodies at every moment of his career. We must retire this extremist, elect Val Demings and expand our Democratic Senate majority!

Cecile Richards

| | | Friend,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $5 makes a difference. $5 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zkb9tpb6tbpdlvahfa6lkrsvgdldgfvevd7tr16o_rp22sh2s8i66or4c3ie8ob4chh2bs "Johnson1")**_

Please, Friend, our future is counting on our actions today.

Thanks for reading this email. I appreciate you and your family.

Thank you for your support,
Ron

As I have told crowds since my first Tea Party speeches: this is a fight for freedom. **This is not someone else 's fight, this is our fight, and it's a fight we absolutely must win.** As a grandpa, dad, and businessman, I refuse to lose our country to radicals and woke liberals with their socialist agenda. body:
Cheri Beasley gives me hope.
#

Hi friends, it’s Cory Booker. I’m reaching out today on behalf of my friend Cheri Beasley.

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Peter, it would be an honor if you continued to support me - can you spare $25 to help me continue my fight in the Senate?

It's no secret why Rubio is panicking: I'm closing the polling gap between us, supporters like you helped me outraise him last quarter nearly 3-to-1, and now, after months of trailing in the polls, TWO new polls show that this race is officially TIED!

body:
[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=792%2E5257348%2E_he_IU ]Adam Schiff for Congress

Derek — With only 36 hours until our August fundraising
deadline, is there anything we can say to convince you to donate to Adam's
campaign?

What if we told you that just in this month alone, despite our incredibly
slim margins in Congress, we passed the biggest investment in our climate
and renewable energy in our country's history — while also allowing
Medicare to negotiate down the cost of prescription drugs?

What if we told you that if we're able to hold our House majority and
expand our Senate majority by a few seats, we could deliver even more,
like abolishing the filibuster, codifying Roe, raising the minimum wage,
and banning assault weapons? And make more climate investments? And lift
more children and families out of poverty?

What if we told you that Republicans have continued to vote against
legislation that benefits the American people? All the while, they
continue to take extraordinary amounts of money from corporate
billionaires. Just last week, a right-wing billionaire and donor gave $1.6
billion to a conservative non-profit that will use that money to fight
against voting rights, climate action, and abortion rights.

What if we told you that if Republicans take control, they could send our
country backward, ending meaningful oversight and paving the way for
another dangerous and abusive Trump administration? In fact, Kevin
McCarthy is already threatening to strip Adam of his committee assignments
if Republicans take the House, and Donald Trump is attacking Adam at every
opportunity so that he can rile up his extreme MAGA base.

No one would have thought Democrats would get so much done in a 50-50
Senate in just one month, with no margin for error. But we did.

The work of government is often slow and cumbersome. But together, in
August, we passed the Inflation Reduction Act (which attacked climate and
lowered drug prices), the PACT Act (initially blocked by Republicans,
which provides additional healthcare to veterans), the CHIPS and Science
Act (which will invest hundreds of billions of dollars into the
manufacturing of the future right here in the United States), and took
action resulting in gas prices dropping for the entire month.

But this is just the beginning, and we’re clear-eyed about the stakes and
the possibilities of the next two years. If we can protect and expand our
Democratic majorities this November, more progressive policies will come
to fruition and push our nation forward.

So are you ready to contribute, Derek?

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=aug2022_abs_em.vZ_ypc&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EOM_AC_20220830_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1004&akid=792%2E5257348%2E_he_IU ]Please add your support. We have less than 36 hours till our
end-of-month fundraising deadline. Any amount helps us reach our goal and
supports Adam as we move closer to Election Day.

If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your
donation will go through immediately:

| | | Friend,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $5 makes a difference. $5 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](http://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=845030739fa74d8a8c3233c105fbd8a5&_e=Mf2FMtPAhp0gmrHzEnBln895XoXThaezpQiYGTVgxPbQxxJpPuHElqS1bAnnNkD5VI5TfWSuukfOkcn41kQi17OIjbT19OMqpzz__BsmQIvdVdca2MO1Vg0_vDmpcfJhWDmW0RywSKOC-VjQNw7v3RDb8KOCfH2By-kreByhdZlNP8lcNUHwBpzDepnrfI3RiaFtpxQ-Trb6ARWjrqS8hyEbMlTOZDNHiXGqs9yoNnM6H5cUkugaTJYihXHKgdyTV21_qc_rgpHbws_a35if1WgeXtJBfqiRckO4TIG27RZt1I3za3pOOYkCW9oV2I0wnONpxSvpgu_6FfRYAPpAO89ckErslavh4lcCMDJwulH_epTvP6xmeh0naEqBWm4gjVxYODUK9V5Pr3wo--apJKesyMy6NeDH8t8AesJ0vY0%3D "Johnson1")**_

Ron

| | | Friend,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $5 makes a difference. $5 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=e748739b796140f1833c9e4853f66680&_e=Uts-qnomhZu-F_LmD6D9m9Z7OhiXbi9c_3gXSv9C1ivsGJowoiP6sFKSl1vzpzyAvMnw4FAM6Rg29U7idNZHdXoNRdUUd4L8MA5qDTD3vTnSVbCIQIYIHpRweCNPOJDUaBoMjchOhPcPFRvi8_5rmzYkL9L7wm_UJf00rq03wR3ce_q2oygU0Hf3uNC0eYVEovovPAGmJGTMeq01kXd2libXzW6h_Sq2A3lbR7Gyp0_JPKqfR3M3lMZXkA3qptNz20YvC9KMY2hwBh1A502eu9UmcrhEmQ25hXZzavpdjDBUMgrZDpxc-JAtW0GZy5wuapYiJG0oOPJSIIpDk0I34aNHJU7fpTQmyPI8jghZ-z7o1Kl9-a3u2KIQH6pe1RzNj9PKNx0Qi1zktl8gaNCOsfb5rfdGo-UZc7CupSNxa4M%3D "Johnson1")**_

I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign. I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs. No donation is too small. $5 makes a difference. $5 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red. Friend, I know that in a neck-and-neck race like this one, it's easy to focus solely on things like the latest polling numbers or the day's fundraising goal. **So I want to quickly explain exactly what we're fighting for – and _why_ winning here in Georgia matters so much.** Our movement is about building a better, brighter future for _all_. It's about ensuring that everyone has an equal voice in our government – and a fair shot at the American dream. That means defending and expanding our constitutional right to vote. It means protecting reproductive freedom nationwide. It means making health care more affordable, bringing economic justice to our communities, and lowering the everyday costs that make it difficult for too many families to make ends meet. **Friend, our movement is about you – your priorities, your concerns, your hopes for the future. That's why it's so important to have you by my side for the critical fights ahead – fights we can only win if we win this election first.** You see, polls show me 1 point behind my GOP opponent, Herschel Walker – who seems to care more about courting favor from Donald Trump than he does about addressing the issues that matter to Georgians. Being raised by two working parents who sometimes struggled to make ends meet wasn’t always easy. Flying combat missions in Desert Storm wasn’t easy. Watching Gabby struggle during her recovery in the days, weeks, and months after her shooting wasn’t easy.
**Running for the U.S. Senate and having Donald Trump, his hand-picked, “Hardcore-MAGA” candidate in Arizona, and national Republicans relentlessly attack me personally hasn’t been easy either.**

Being raised by two working parents who sometimes struggled to make ends meet wasn’t always easy. Flying combat missions in Desert Storm wasn’t easy. Watching Gabby struggle during her recovery in the days, weeks, and months after her shooting wasn’t easy. Running for the U.S. Senate and having Donald Trump, his hand-picked, “Hardcore-MAGA” candidate in Arizona, and national Republicans relentlessly attack me personally hasn’t been easy either. But as a kid, I had my brother Scott. In combat, I had my wingmen. With Gabby, we had our whole community and committed nurses and doctors offering support. And in this campaign, I have you. Together, we can take on the MAGA-right and corporate special interest groups who want to defeat us --and win. It’ll take an entire team of supporters joining forces to fuel this mission and hold the Senate, so I’m humbly asking: Can I count on you to split a $10 donation between my campaign and the DNC today before tomorrow’s critical end-of-month deadline? Any amount will make a huge difference. I’ve never been one to shy away from a challenge, Derek. So even after Donald Trump endorsed a far-right extremist in this race and national Republicans continue to spend millions of dollars to defeat me, I’m not giving up -- and I hope you won’t either. Peter, the last few weeks leading up to the Democratic primary in Missouri have been a whirlwind, to say the least. Now that we're past the primary election, I finally have a free moment, so I want to take a second to reintroduce myself and tell you a bit more about why I'm running for Senate.
I've spent my whole life in Missouri. As a young girl growing up here, I watched my parents live the American Dream.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50004564/364246513/-1843232826?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk247-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmZWY5NmQyZC1iODI4LWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=fDJow9Vtt_FAcVjxZ5sPgFLhS2E9ct0t0LRzpH9atzI=)
At a young age, my parents taught me that “to whom much is given, much is required.” That sense of duty to help others is what drove me to choose a life of service.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50004565/364246514/-1843232826?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk247-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmZWY5NmQyZC1iODI4LWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=fDJow9Vtt_FAcVjxZ5sPgFLhS2E9ct0t0LRzpH9atzI=)
When I was a kid, I dreamed of becoming a nurse. To me, nurses were the real superheroes. They took care of people and saved lives. That’s what I wanted to do – so I set out to make it happen.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50004566/364246515/-1843232826?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk247-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmZWY5NmQyZC1iODI4LWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=fDJow9Vtt_FAcVjxZ5sPgFLhS2E9ct0t0LRzpH9atzI=)
As a young woman, I fulfilled my dream of becoming a nurse. Right after nursing school, I worked at a hospital and cared for children, seniors, people who relied on Medicare and Medicaid for their healthcare, and folks from all walks of life.

I wrote it as I was preparing to run for State Senate for the very first time. I remember being filled with the worries that come with any new challenge, and I wrote this as a way to remind myself why I was choosing to run for office. I want to take a minute to share it with you: **Why am I going to run?**

_To improve people’s lives. To bring jobs, economic prosperity, and hope for the future to my community. To push people to be their best selves._ _To get people more engaged. To make lasting positive change. To change minds, to tweak beliefs about what is possible, to elevate the discussion. To bring more compassion and understanding._ _To change the way we engage with ideas. To push people to look beyond easy answers. To make the political arena safe for nuance. To help us find the overlap. To move away from demonizing each other. To build coalitions._ _To teach about give and take. To fulfill a calling. To use my gifts and talents to serve others. To enjoy the challenge of a very difficult job._ **It’s now eight years later, and every word of this letter still rings true.** This campaign isn’t about me – it’s about bringing the voices of the people to Washington, igniting change, and making a meaningful difference in the lives of people like you. If you’re with me, then I’m asking for your support. **Before tomorrow’s end-of-month deadline, we are just about 20 donations shy of 500 Founding Donors to my General Election Fund – a number that’s mission-critical in order to sustain our campaign and win this November.[Can you help us cross the finish line and ensure we have the resources to keep our campaign going strong post-primary?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50004970/364247897/-1680921792?refcode=E18043-20220830-EOM2-SL-DeadlineEOM-RegTemplate-NA-NA&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM0MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxOTZkOTJiMy1iOTI4LWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UpsMXRQIn30bUIOtJkCmRp1HOgCiAwtO7WHLh24dc3k=)** | _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation to Becca's campaign for Congress will go through immediately:_ | **[$5](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50004971/364247898/-1680921792?express_lane=true&refcode=E18043-20220830-EOM2-EG-DeadlineEOM-RegTemplate-NA-NA&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM0MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxOTZkOTJiMy1iOTI4LWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UpsMXRQIn30bUIOtJkCmRp1HOgCiAwtO7WHLh24dc3k=)** | **[$15](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50004972/364247899/-1680921792?express_lane=true&refcode=E18043-20220830-EOM2-EG-DeadlineEOM-RegTemplate-NA-NA&amount=15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM0MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxOTZkOTJiMy1iOTI4LWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UpsMXRQIn30bUIOtJkCmRp1HOgCiAwtO7WHLh24dc3k=)**

The Senate is the final defense against abortion being banned in the United States.

Friend — I have about 15 minutes of free time in my schedule today. I know that doesn’t sound like a lot of time, but with a schedule like mine, I can assure you it’s a gift. And while I know campaigns send a lot of emails your way, I want to take a few of these minutes to tell you about my decision to run for Senate in the first place — and why your support today is so important to our success. The truth is: When Gabby and I first started talking about running, we weren’t sure what to expect. We knew that Arizona needed new leadership in the Senate — someone who would always put the people of our state first, who was willing to work across the aisle to deliver real results, and who would prioritize building bridges between the two parties — not burning them down. We also knew we had some friends who would help us out. But when you’re talking about such a big campaign, we realized we’d need support from a lot of people we hadn’t met yet. Especially since I was making the decision to reject corporate PAC money. You know the rest. We won in 2020 in large part because we ran the biggest grassroots campaign Arizona has ever seen. But now we have a new mission: Re-election. And we’ve got our work cut out for us. The stakes were high before, but now it’s more critical than ever that we win this race. Because the Senate is the final defense against a national abortion ban in the United States. And in Arizona, the candidate that Trump endorsed against me wants to go even further than the Supreme Court. He’s called for a national ban on abortion. He’s said abortion rights were “demonic.” And he backs a law that would jail abortion providers. I know times are tough, but we can’t give in now. We need to make sure a ban like that never happens. name: Ron Johnson
subject: a personal plea
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ron Johnson For Senate, Inc
body:
|
---
| | | Friend,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $5 makes a difference. $5 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=d84dde4c83ae4997ad57f779c7689850&_e=v9WFSHXYB0mnRnxAvndsxi0kCKM-dHjqHid0NMIMhxq4B4tVx4dxMKtnkSTluyB5NNcw-mOwTIGhldArM3wkHbYlEA1X11BYEZX6DUbilPCOTr03BjeYWDCjCjc-WY6B6VKA4nvztFwkEbz1OIHn9x-1EmvPBndB_zgl049Y0tAr5R7DV0mCgQ1FkMLnZwxncc17jugQJCtNAqd4Q4fF__vbjbwMj0Sqyt4srvhfALECIIRbWBBIQTiaQBEW-gFyJeChOQAvdy6UmDJz7aBLUTPgWjXy3BtXVYHmhG-Yh7MpZareA2XkVPlukKhoVu0ksdmpL2U2MpWOSjxedSd1kNzthNZ9Hs_LkjRT4-Bd710SFbMk5end36_YzOYRcO9F2xGUTLL6Sm9S4BXiAepGg73f6VE_1fnwMhwfLDyzUAM%3D "Johnson1")**_

Please, Friend, our future is counting on our actions today.

Thanks for reading this email. I appreciate you and your family.

Thank you for your support,
Ron

| |

A note from Ron Johnson: America is in peril. President Reagan warned that freedom is fragile, always one generation away from extinction. As I have told crowds since my first Tea Party speeches: this is a fight for freedom. **This is not someone else’s fight, this is our fight, and it’s a fight we absolutely must win.** As a grandpa, dad, and businessman, I refuse to lose our country to radicals and woke liberals with their socialist agenda. I refuse to jeopardize America's future. I know you feel the same.

body:
| Did you see Dr. Mack’s note? She works with Annie at the hospital and has seen firsthand the work that Annie does for Lowcountry families. **[Chip in before tomorrow’s deadline, then read Dr. Mack’s message below.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49994509/364207384/-137508228?amount=25&source=EM_NBI_AA_20220830_FR_EOM.2.7_0_3MO_Campaign_NA_NA_EOM&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzk0MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkNDE1ODgyNC05YTI4LWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=XjXqMq-XJvqYM2cbntd4e0D8bgh7NHOb7ngmCnJ7hv4=)**

* * *
**_Begin Forwarded Message:_**

Hi there,

I’m Dr. Elizabeth Mack and I work with Dr. Andrews.

name: Val Demings
subject: I'm the Democratic nominee to defeat Marco Rubio
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ron Be Gone, Inc
body:
This is what keeps me winning
| [](https://act.ronbegone.com/go/11539?t=6&akid=1362%2E564421%2EbonQcv) Each and every day, it is not lost on me that I'm in what will undoubtedly be the most expensive 2022 race for the U.S. Senate – a race that can decide the Senate majority and will be anything but easy.

But I know a thing or two about persevering, and winning, even if the odds are stacked against me.

I've overcome plenty of adversity in my life. There was nothing easy about growing up as a poor, Black girl in the segregated South. But my family's faith, and faith in opportunity, taught me perseverance. It was my family, particularly my mother's words of, "Never tire of doing good, Val" that pushed me to where I am.

I carry the spirit of her words with me even today – as I reflect about my career of service to Floridians and my path to being a candidate for the U.S. Senate. [](https://act.ronbegone.com/go/11540?t=7&akid=1362%2E564421%2EbonQcv) **There was nothing easy about being a first-generation college graduate** – nor was it easy working my way up the ranks of the Orlando Police Department. For 27 years, I served when it wasn't exactly ordinary to see a woman on the force, let alone a Black woman. But I never tired, and eventually, I became the first woman to lead my department as chief of police.

And I know firsthand **there's nothing easy about winning elections in Florida.** My first run for Congress was one of my toughest fights – but even in defeat, I never tired because I knew I could do good for my community. And it certainly wasn't easy to hold a lawless president – a habitual offender – to account. But I served as an impeachment manager, prosecuting Donald Trump in the Senate because no one should be above the law.

My road to this moment was not easy, and I'm not sure that in anywhere but America could a little Black girl, the daughter of a maid and a janitor growing up in the South in the '60s, have a story so filled with opportunities like these. And I am determined to meet this moment, to win, to never tire of doing good, so that anyone can have a story of opportunity.

**This may be my toughest challenge yet, which is why I'm urging you – every last person reading this email – to chip in whatever you can to ensure I have the resources to defeat Marco Rubio and win in Florida:** [Please, will you split $10 or more between me and Ron Be Gone to help me flip Florida blue and defend our Democratic Senate majority? # Friends,

Hope you have been doing well. We have some updates on the upcoming Weekend of Action as well as an exclusive opportunity for you all to purchase tickets for a campaign event featuring Congressman David Trone before we announce it!

WEEKEND OF ACTION

**Thursday, 9/1 - Community Conversation-Raiser at 6:45pm at The Real Deal Jamaican Restaurant**
[Facebook Event Page](https://grossmanforhagerstown.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f768a13072224eb624b84e1f&id=540f502435&e=db24e76724)
_(LOCATION CHANGE: In order to give some support and awareness to our local small businesses and their role in the community, we will be holding the Conversation-Raiser event at The Real Deal Jamaican Restaurant!)_
I want to hear your worries, complaints, concerns, hopes, and ideas for how Hagerstown can be better represented! We'll be joined by other local representatives and candidates, including Shawn Perry for State Senate, for a great conversation on how we can move forward together.

**Friday, 9/2 - Door-knocking Kickoff from 12:45pm to 3pm (Meeting at the park on the corner of Belview Ave and W Hillcrest Rd in Hagerstown)**
[Facebook Event Page](https://grossmanforhagerstown.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f768a13072224eb624b84e1f&id=bf1e87a780&e=db24e76724)
We'll be joined by the campaigns of Congressman David Trone and Shawn Perry for State Senate to hit the pavement in Hagerstown and connect with voters.

[Facebook Event Page](https://grossmanforhagerstown.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f768a13072224eb624b84e1f&id=59a60a68f7&e=db24e76724)

\---

OTHER EVENTS

[Facebook Event Page](https://grossmanforhagerstown.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f768a13072224eb624b84e1f&id=36f0dc231b&e=db24e76724) | [Eventbrite Page](https://grossmanforhagerstown.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f768a13072224eb624b84e1f&id=1005826c73&e=db24e76724)
Join Brooke Grossman for Cocktails & Chat about how she will revamp our representation. Snacks, drinks, and engaging discussions provided!

PLEASE PURCHASE TICKETS HERE: [bit.ly/BrookeCocktails](https://grossmanforhagerstown.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f768a13072224eb624b84e1f&id=eb3c705924&e=db24e76724)

Tickets are $38.77 each due to $3.77 in processing fees.

**Saturday, 9/17 - Meet and Greet Fundraiser with Brooke and Congressman David Trone from 4:30pm to 7:30pm (LOCATION PROVIDED WITH TICKET PURCHASE)**

Brooke Grossman

It would mean the world to me if you took a few minutes to read this email. I thought I’d take a second to walk you through my life, my story, and how it led me here – running for Senator of Pennsylvania. And I think what I have to say is pretty important...

**The beginning:** My parents are Turkish immigrants who moved to America when my father was training to become a doctor. Growing up as a child of immigrants, I witnessed my family’s sacrifices. body:
We need Alexandria organizing, not on the phone fundraising.
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20220830-3343-header&t=1&akid=3343%2E2526796%2ETf6DsU)
Unlike most politicians, Alexandria doesn’t spend time on the phone calling corporate donors. Instead, her time and energy is dedicated to serving her community and working people across the country – as it should be.
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220830.dvYf99&refcode=em20220830-3343-P_FND_EOM_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=3343%2E2526796%2ETf6DsU)
We need Alexandria out in the world organizing with workers and communities, not fundraising. That’s why our movement pitches in through online donations – $5 or $10 at a time through emails like these, so Alexandria can stay focused on fighting for bold legislation, organizing our communities, and standing up against powerful special interests.
**But to be frank, in order to hit our $150,000 goal for August, we need to pick up the pace on our fundraising.** If at least one in three people reading this email chips in, we’ll make up the difference in no time – but we know not everyone is in the place to give today and we completely understand.
[If you’re able to, can you contribute $3 before our deadline tomorrow? Your donation will help guarantee that Alexandria has the resources to stay focused on the work that matters and win her election in November.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220830.dvYf99&refcode=em20220830-3343-P_FND_EOM_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=3343%2E2526796%2ETf6DsU)
**[Contribute $3](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220830.dvYf99&refcode=em20220830-3343-P_FND_EOM_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&akid=3343%2E2526796%2ETf6DsU)**
From joining Starbucks workers in Astoria, Queens to celebrate them becoming the first unionized Starbucks in New York City, to urging President Biden to cancel student debt – we need Alexandria’s voice.
Our campaign is only possible because of the support and dedication from individuals like you – so thank you for all that you do today and everyday.
– Team AOC

name: Team Booker
subject: How we plan on defeating Rand Paul
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Booker for Kentucky
body:
[1]Charles Booker

Exactly how do we plan on defeating Rand Paul,
Peter? It’s a question we’ve been
getting a lot, even before Charles announced his run for the U.S. Senate.

We get it. The last time a Democrat won a U.S. Senate election in Kentucky
was in 1999. But it’s becoming increasingly clear that we have a real shot
at winning this race.

Similar to the movement we saw in Georgia in 2021, and in Kansas earlier
this year, there is significant evidence that huge shifts are happening in
our politics and that Kentucky is on track to make history in 2022.

We’ll dive into the details of our plans in just a moment. [ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18486?c0=20220830.sqFn4l&refcode=em20220830-2417&t=1001&akid=2417%2E346206%2E6HNaVM ]We hope that
after reading you’ll chip in $5 or whatever you can toward
our $100,000 August fundraising goal so we can build the ambitious
grassroots organizing movement we need to reach out to voters in all 120
counties of Kentucky and end Rand Paul’s disastrous rule in office.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18485?c0=20220830.cW_HYb&refcode=em20220830-2417&t=1020&akid=2417%2E346206%2E6HNaVM ]Contribute $23.81 →

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18485?c0=20220830.cW_HYb&refcode=em20220830-2417&t=1021&akid=2417%2E346206%2E6HNaVM ][IMG]

Let’s start by explaining the situation: The truth is there’s a long
history of voter suppression in our Commonwealth. As a result, the number
of people who don’t vote outnumber those who do. Black and brown
communities in particular have long been counted out in our elections.
Kentucky is also one of just a few states with a recently elected
Democratic governor and two Republican senators.
Peter, the
tides are turning.

Recently, Democrats (like Charles!) have seen success by building
campaigns that mobilize the people our politicians have ignored for too
long. From the hood to the holler, Charles is building a level of
excitement and enthusiasm we haven’t seen in decades. He isn’t afraid to
advocate for bold solutions to combat the climate crisis, police violence,
and income inequality. He’s a proven leader who knows what challenges
Kentuckians are going through because he’s been there himself. That’s
exactly the kind of candidate we need to defeat Rand Paul.

So here’s our plan to get Charles’ message out and what we’re doing right
now: We plan on running an ambitious field program to register voters,
show up for disenfranchised communities, and make sure all of our voices –
from the hood to the holler – are heard this election. But we’re just 10
weeks away from Election Day, and we have a lot of work to do.

That means we need to start investing ASAP in:

* Building a grassroots network of organizers
* Training volunteer coordinators
* Purchasing voter outreach tools
* Printing campaign literature
* Setting up a fund to pay for gas for our teams as they travel across
Kentucky

There are 120 counties in Kentucky and we want to invest in organizers and
volunteers in every single one of them so we can leverage our grassroots
power. We’re building the infrastructure we need to win, but we can’t do
it without you.

Here’s how you can help,
Peter: Our campaign relies on
grassroots donations from people like you. That’s why our average donation
is only $23.81. If enough folks chip in, our donations amount to a
powerful movement, so we’re setting a goal to raise $100,000 before the
end of the month.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18485?c0=20220830.cW_HYb&refcode=em20220830-2417&t=1022&akid=2417%2E346206%2E6HNaVM ]Will you chip in $23.81 or anything you can to help us start building
the historic grassroots movement we need to elect Charles in just ten
weeks? We have the momentum and energy to defeat Rand Paul but it’s going
to take hard work from all of us to send Charles to the U.S. Senate —
starting with reaching this goal of $100,000 by midnight tomorrow.

In 10 weeks, we will shock the country, take a historic stand for
democracy, and defeat Rand Paul.

Let’s get to work.

Team Booker

Contribute to Charles Booker: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cb-email-donate?refcode=em20220830-2417-footer&t=1023&refcode2=2417_346206_6HNaVM&akid=2417%2E346206%2E6HNaVM

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. If you need to remove yourself from our email list, click here to unsubscribe:

You can unsubscribe from this mailing list at any time:
http://act.charlesbooker.org/cms/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?akid=2417%2E346206%2E6HNaVM

Contributions to Booker for Kentucky are not deductible for federal income tax purposes.

subject: We must reverse the blacklist
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

There should be no place in the Democratic Party for union-busters,
lobbyists for GOP tax loopholes, PR firms who try to hide sexual assault
for their clients, nor consultants for Big Oil, Big Pharma, charter
schools, and right-wing foreign policy hawks.

Yet, the DNC, DSCC, DCCC, and other Democrats employ firms engaged in
corporate mercenary work, like union-busting, right-wing lobbying, and
blocking progressive change.

It’s time for the Democratic Party to end all business with any
consultants doing corporate mercenary work — for the sake of the future of
the Democratic party and our entire democratic system.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/113456?t=1002&akid=24939%2E1203867%2EAgMys6 ]We need your support, Peter, to
demand that the Democratic Party ends business with corporate firms who
are involved in union-busting and right-wing lobbying. Will you add your
name right now?

Add your name

In 2019, the DCCC blacklisted vendors, staffers, and organizations that
supported primary challengers to corporate-backed Democratic incumbents.

It was a shocking attempt to protect corporate incumbents by blocking
working-class progressives from a slew of critical campaign resources. The
Democratic establishment created this blacklist after AOC defeated the 4th
most powerful Democrat in the House. Why? Because corporate-backed
Democrats didn’t want to lose more primaries to our candidates.

The Democratic Party must be the party of the working class, not the party
of paying consultants who do corporate mercenary work.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/113456?t=1003&akid=24939%2E1203867%2EAgMys6 ]Please add your name now to call on the Democratic Party to stop using
consultants who blatantly are working against Democratic values.

Thank you for being with us,

Justice Democrats

Peter, I just left the debate stage after facing off with my primary opponents.
The difference between myself and the rest of the field could not be more clear. I am a lifelong resident of the Second District who intimately knows the issues our community faces - and I've dedicated my life to making Rhode Island a better place to live, work, and raise a family. I'm asking you to join us in this fight right now and chip in to keep up our momentum. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/joy-fox-for-congress-1]
It's no secret that these are challenging times. Too many families are struggling. Often I am asked "How can we make Washington work?"
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/joy-fox-for-congress-1 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/joy-fox-for-congress-1]
The fact is, if we want Washington to work for us, we’ve got to change the kind of people we send there.
And that is the difference here. My lifetime of lived experience gives me a strong and unique understanding of the Second District and the ability to get things done for you. I didn’t just move here and I don’t just summer here.
It’s time to send the first Democratic woman to Congress from Rhode Island. A woman who has been part of a team that has beaten Allan Fung twice. We can do it again.
Please chip in right now to help us do the work necessary between now and the September 13 primary. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/joy-fox-for-congress-1]

Joy

Peter,

I’ve been given an ultimatum.

**If I’m not able to raise an additional $100,000 by August 31st, the national Republican Party wont’ send in the troops.**

I have to be able to show the good folks at the RNC that I’m able to stand on my own two feet before they’re willing to open up their coffers and help out our campaign.

With only 2 days to go, we’re still short about $9,500. **[If you’re in a position to give, would you make a generous contribution to my campaign today?](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=c28c540d06614cdca5dfe7ee8d555dc3&_e=UuNkHs81_Zi2G7kemlodyYhJV46NsdvQEI-7YAqorYjVtv3RS7m0lKF4tw1aSNfhvOuyZG2zi0Gqe4jasVcQNlS84j-mFDs5PTVWYFe1aqVkNebNi_ya3scI7Hj1psNmRDw1mARg_nNhDOG1eXXRi9LdSac_1ZTT4DqwhmkWg-2fgTzPHzyH5KMy6abymI1i_8AOvma3RT-c7HY9pY10YQRwcIRi4qC3d60VLAJHaQGVzWD5zmUAjFixHoaz9WGjmvt1DObHFXd7W2fPOL0vRj3kHV_UA-h_0lmVjJp7PviiNhLKJbZEkmOV2KrLO_3MOIRz2ImWZUhtgDJp09D1GUMby_aDrq4uizmdXwjcUvU5y8hdMjMtBsQwChAdDWy71d3r-FNcGzwQMGQ-PyxwEawjvTpWwDvYLBRWSe9zyWM%3D)**

**[If you’re on the fence about donating to my campaign, remember this race has national implications. The outcome of my race could well determine which party controls the House next year.](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=c28c540d06614cdca5dfe7ee8d555dc3&_e=UuNkHs81_Zi2G7kemlodyYhJV46NsdvQEI-7YAqorYjVtv3RS7m0lKF4tw1aSNfhvOuyZG2zi0Gqe4jasVcQNlS84j-mFDs5PTVWYFe1aqVkNebNi_ya3scI7Hj1psNmRDw1mARg_nNhDOG1eXXRi9LdSac_1ZTT4DqwhmkWg-2fgTzPHzyH5KMy6abymI1i_8AOvma3RT-c7HY9pY10YQRwcIRi4qC3d60VLAJHaQGVzWD5zmUAjFixHoaz9WGjmvt1DObHFXd7W2fPOL0vRrCYBYNwy4dbLkEMBzXxp6jEiMpvS13BX7X1GlYFbKEGqwgeKd8JIhXPsotX4JIbh12Uf2gXitKivm2IZQmD8P1RxZbh-gsozc10DU1Z96smy5F5KgclMybnTFyqfWi3qhiC3A2UKyp5Rg0ekzIsVKs%3D)**

Friend, The Republican Party is a danger to the United States. This Sunday, Lindsey Graham, a sitting United States Senator, former US Air Force Reserve Colonel, and former GOP presidential candidate, threatened that there would be “riots in the street” if former president Donald Trump is prosecuted for taking classified government documents to his private Mar-a-Lago residence after leaving the White House. Let that sink in: a leader of the Republican Party is threatening to unleash a civil insurrection if Trump is held accountable for breaking the law. And what was the reaction from Republicans? Did they condemn the remarks as inflammatory? Was Graham forced to walk them back? No. There was silence from the right. Silence from Doug LaMalfa. **The GOP is saying the quiet part out loud. They have, to quote Biden, embraced fascism.** I have seen "violence in the streets." I served two years in Iraq as that nation tore itself apart. All of these so-called patriots are playing with fire -- and they will burn down American democracy if we do not stop them. _****_Learn More About Chuck_**

---
---
| | | Family, hard work and community. These are the things that have defined me as a person more than anything else and are the things that make New Hampshire a special place. Several local Salem community leaders became role models and mentors and got me involved with helping our community. With their encouragement, I ran for Salem Selectman and won. I ran for Town Moderator and won. Then I ran for State Representative and served for two terms from 1998-2002. I was elected to the State Senate in 2002 and was appointed to the Finance Committee. My experience running a business, meeting a payroll, and keeping a conservative budget helped prepare me for the challenges of crafting a balanced state budget. I quickly became known as one of the state’s leaders in budgeting and tax policy. I took a step back from politics in 2006. My daughter was starting her junior year in high school and Susan and I spent most of the next few years traveling to her field hockey and basketball games. We were her biggest fans. In 2010, I was reelected to the Senate. When I returned to the Finance Committee, I found the financial mess that the Democrats had put our state in. The state had an $800 million deficit. We quickly turned that around and put the state’s finances back on a sustainable path. For my work, colleagues gave me the greatest honor of my life — electing me the Senate President in 2013. In 2020, I led Republican efforts to retake the majority in the State Senate. New Hampshire was the only state in the country that was able to flip a blue state legislature to red and it was largely due to our strong fight against the Democrats’ proposed state income tax. Last year, we passed one of the most conservative and fiscally responsible budgets that New Hampshire has ever seen. It is balanced, cuts taxes for small businesses, provides more than $300 million in property tax relief, bans late-term abortions, and prohibits the use of discriminatory teaching in our schools. It puts New Hampshire on a path to long-term prosperity. The work ethic, commitment to family and sense of community that I learned at a young age have stuck with me as an adult and drive everything I do. I still wake up at 4am every morning to work at our business before going to Concord to do the people’s business. More often than not, I still take my first phone calls of the day while driving a tractor. Washington, D.C. has enough silver-spoon, Ivy League lawyers. I believe that I am a product of all the best parts of New Hampshire — the spirit of freedom, sense of volunteerism and responsibility of giving back to the community that has helped shape me into the person I am today. I want to bring New Hampshire to Washington and makes sure our voices are heard. I want to bring New Hampshire values to a place that needs them now more than ever. I want to work for you and I hope you will consider electing me to represent you in the U.S. Senate.

**U.S. Senate, Wisconsin
In Wisconsin, WFP candidate **Mandela Barnes will take on one of the Republican Party’s most vulnerable Senators, Ron Johnson.** Mandela’s upbringing and experience as a community organizer led him to political life and his current role fighting for all Wisconsinites as Lt. Governor. Growing up in one of the most impoverished neighborhoods in Wisconsin, Mandela witnessed firsthand the impact his parents’ union jobs had on their situation. Since then, he’s dedicated his life to addressing the issues affecting working people and the middle class.
**Instead of lining the pockets of billionaires, Mandela would support legislation to create good jobs, address climate change, expand access to high-quality, affordable childcare, and more.
