Peter,

When my colleagues see me coming, they joke and say, [**"there’s Barr, so it must be something about horses, bourbon, Toyota, coal, or the University of Kentucky!"**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=fee25e7cfdaf48609eb6b988e6b5623b&_e=ZDin8aWz-miQ6AHx7h0nU9A-sPTt1nsgQ1fBMwtwz8i2D40aPr9_lFMwTCdBjabs-71k3kMkVRLmYMWxCibfeCjUwPoTesISvcSk6Q-R7E1J5lEJ3_5rcCn9G6tWmLjAWkbAIXBzyqaBwRmUKhEbPnn0EH_Mf0dp9at2skr1t1Vfid-dtgEi9N6tGiwj56zjfKNiZi40XywaRMHYRQ7XTl-l7agKDUHqyaAFz2Tt4K8yiLptgCf8nz3aAjw8mtrpS7iwzRfg_zSl9eOyM6BSYFCO5sIvbhni6PvdJis-7kuUcW3Gzou0LGtzV6vEvtlbJ5Y4wiaL8Nm44yyTV6wJhErMJZ5IAQzeThnlShcG5zi9SiShZ5CPGoYsJbuLubmj)

_And they’re not wrong..._ I bleed Kentucky through and through. It’s where my family has always been, it’s the place that shaped me into the man I am, and it’s the Commonwealth that I’ve been so blessed to represent in Congress.

Now, towards the end of this email, I’m going to request something from you, but first, I want you to understand who I am, how I became the man I am, and what I’m hoping for my future and the future of my daughters.

Growing up, my sister was diagnosed with juvenile arthritis. Our family had to come together to support her treatment. _This taught me that family is the most important thing, compassion is essential, struggle is inevitable, and perseverance is necessary._

It also showed me the need for high-quality, affordable and accessible healthcare for families - [**which continues to be a top issue for me in Congress.**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=fee25e7cfdaf48609eb6b988e6b5623b&_e=ZDin8aWz-miQ6AHx7h0nU9A-sPTt1nsgQ1fBMwtwz8i2D40aPr9_lFMwTCdBjabs-71k3kMkVRLmYMWxCibfeCjUwPoTesISvcSk6Q-R7E1J5lEJ3_5rcCn9G6tWmLjAWkbAIXBzyqaBwRmUKhEbPnn0EH_Mf0dp9at2skr1t1Vfid-dtgEi9N6tGiwj56zjfKNiZi40XywaRMHYRQ7XTl-l7agKDUHqyaAFz2Tt4K9WmWYb0dFFEEsUnpRza1nlflAZ9KBXWNb2ibhVxjOak2Q0JqqBz7AiPvdoR-dpK94HttSax9SwxbpD6ko02xBJ1hnsuk3wjAv1nM4hY1496Co5GQRjA01pq3vAMOu3ROcBnZsNq9_Yy-H3Pnlp_Gud)

My love for Kentucky met my interest in politics when I first interned in Washington in college. The ability to work on and fight for legislative policies that helped conservative causes was so rewarding.

Ultimately, I took a chance and ran for Congress in my hometown of Lexington against an incumbent Democrat and lost by 647 votes in one of the closest races in the country. But I recalled the lessons I learned as a child, and I persevered. Two years later I ran again and I was elected. [**Since being in Congress, I’ve fought hard for issues that actually matter to families like tax cuts, American energy, and affordable, high-quality healthcare options.**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=fee25e7cfdaf48609eb6b988e6b5623b&_e=ZDin8aWz-miQ6AHx7h0nU9A-sPTt1nsgQ1fBMwtwz8i2D40aPr9_lFMwTCdBjabs-71k3kMkVRLmYMWxCibfeCjUwPoTesISvcSk6Q-R7E1J5lEJ3_5rcCn9G6tWmLjAWkbAIXBzyqaBwRmUKhEbPnn0EH_Mf0dp9at2skr1t1Vfid-dtgEi9N6tGiwj56zjfKNiZi40XywaRMHYRQ7XTl-l7agKDUHqyaAFz2Tt4K8vk_w_dNLVkcCFl4Bdtv2MocZxNCb1m9mfp3tKCcHZNRxZhG2-1S7McVsaMbhgMO7IVf2ySdcBmEfjWDMWOHgrlUqPk4RMCG847KhwzROfnqhEiMw63GH8EJtCr7shEEXqEXmlUZfRjLTzTd76PSeR)

As the father of two young girls, I’ve tried to instill in my daughters the same lessons that my parents taught me as a child: compassion, perseverance, and determination.

[](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=fee25e7cfdaf48609eb6b988e6b5623b&_e=ZDin8aWz-miQ6AHx7h0nU9A-sPTt1nsgQ1fBMwtwz8i2D40aPr9_lFMwTCdBjabs-71k3kMkVRLmYMWxCibfeCjUwPoTesISvcSk6Q-R7E1J5lEJ3_5rcCn9G6tWmLjAWkbAIXBzyqaBwRmUKhEbPnn0EH_Mf0dp9at2skr1t1Vfid-dtgEi9N6tGiwj56zjfKNiZi40XywaRMHYRQ7XTl-l7agKDUHqyaAFz2Tt4K8jjWNU_CBPPf_fPdnXv5JSs4dgD1EcYuvG7EtSmFTE9QsUiq8NrS5mz2G79vw8p0JLYTZxNfThxgHAzYRedLkB8WT_OCbfDgEntTjZtI7pY4PbRz1tGdCA2du3BlDjIHoFprtyIrKnDLzC41UQHaHz)

I take my role as a father very seriously, as do I take my commitment to Kentucky and to America. [**But Peter, what is happening in our country is beyond concerning - it goes against everything I believe in.**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=fee25e7cfdaf48609eb6b988e6b5623b&_e=ZDin8aWz-miQ6AHx7h0nU9A-sPTt1nsgQ1fBMwtwz8i2D40aPr9_lFMwTCdBjabs-71k3kMkVRLmYMWxCibfeCjUwPoTesISvcSk6Q-R7E1J5lEJ3_5rcCn9G6tWmLjAWkbAIXBzyqaBwRmUKhEbPnn0EH_Mf0dp9at2skr1t1Vfid-dtgEi9N6tGiwj56zjfKNiZi40XywaRMHYRQ7XTl-l7agKDUHqyaAFz2Tt4K9rnQGoqlrNywcvjihD32eTyvCWg2RXHA5iko-64TP0a7x4ch5jS1kWVGhMRkC09DbRJNCR7ALxFmzJCCa6EZZrxZI9YogT1nhPnVDu2uUqrbrnd8aU3Hcht4yJZvXnOrHw50bT0B4s1mIX3-Mk1eHG)

_Open borders, a failing economy, a massive energy crisis, un-elected bureaucrats ruling our Nation, suppression of free speech..._

This is not the country I want to pass on to my children.

subject: Personal Letter for Peter
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Republican National Committee
body:
Dear Peter,

Growing up, my dad told me every single day, “You don’t complain about things, you fix them.”

My dad was the hardest worker that I knew. He led by example and action. After he passed, I made the decision to be like my dad: a person of words and of action, because both matter. That’s why I ran for office. I am committed to always serving the people of South Dakota with both words and action. I will do what I say, and I will always tell you what I’m doing.

We learn important lessons from our fathers. My dad's lessons still resonate with me today. Our Founding Fathers taught us many such lessons. They taught us that freedom is a cause worth fighting for. "Give me liberty or give me death," Patrick Henry famously said. So many of the brave men who followed George Washington into battle died in the pursuit of that same liberty.

[**Help Republicans retake Congress
and save America. ⇒**](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=520c9316fb30466aa84e757ac667fbc9&_e=5eh1_kXigsvdlbo5C0dPwkgNOya6UpUIWbirfMtXF6XUsqgo0yMEJLefU2U-o8SG-4E_LTfXTPwHSwsA-QoHxhqv9NESq8nnXT4KgBpgENsPDITQWPO25qeyZPSMVWdTLhhlLWRc0pF4Evl3sJgHuXdHdN9m1ceT7S_bQC7RLCuMTGkikTzYImWMBJ5KYXxHp7axoClb22qdRd6s-HZlEytuCwm4uVn960aX2mVUxmo2VAH_A5_rPpE2uWfkejr9HU3RIdhOo8AAXWFmjRNdYFb0X0IO9KXV9yMep67tE6mVyyyh_lV9zRozjQx4VxldkPjJXVGi6w8i_9zk4dFo3oyno8kN3fdInvPRsI5ZQP1wOx0whpgnNj82sDfP4segJ7qGzCMB6LWzPp69aZNwxjKes9J6IOAlq3thCfMYfd6Z_0n9Q8YtwPbIsiYyIVJn2MKtfvH0KlUl3s4oFNqh1w%3D%3D)
It's easy to forget that before America's Founding, liberty wasn't widely recognized. The rights to "life, liberty, and the pursuit of happiness" that Thomas Jefferson wrote about were a controversial idea at the time. America was the first nation built around those rights.

The lessons that we learn from our fathers don't become less important just because we grow older. And the ideals laid out by our Founding Fathers are no less true in a 21st Century America. As we see threats to those ideals, to American freedom, we need to fight for them with the same vigor as Patrick Henry and the same resolve as George Washington.

[**Will you help us win back
our Republican majority? ⇒**](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=520c9316fb30466aa84e757ac667fbc9&_e=5eh1_kXigsvdlbo5C0dPwkgNOya6UpUIWbirfMtXF6XUsqgo0yMEJLefU2U-o8SG-4E_LTfXTPwHSwsA-QoHxhqv9NESq8nnXT4KgBpgENsPDITQWPO25qeyZPSMVWdTLhhlLWRc0pF4Evl3sJgHuXdHdN9m1ceT7S_bQC7RLCuMTGkikTzYImWMBJ5KYXxHp7axoClb22qdRd6s-HZlEytuCwm4uVn960aX2mVUxmo2VAH_A5_rPpE2uWfkejr9HU3RIdhOo8AAXWFmjRNdYFb0X0IO9KXV9yMep67tE6mVyyyh_lV9zRozjQx4Vxld9hx-hYqxp9-Sugyz0Zq35Cv2wsxErSHcJa1xxfwQXup7SnUO1-AvcrYARqD81SrCDc1EII5Hn2-OkSM9o3QJY2ZAhOZa6HPtj48IRkhI2CMIXir7hnkz36lQUPdDNDPWILKPcqFHyYtKM0_AI_BHHA%3D%3D)
We must fight for the future of our nation. Americans have no faith in Joe Biden and the Democrat Party. But we have not lost faith in ourselves. We will defend American values, rights, and freedoms. We will not let President Biden ruin this great country.

We can retake our Republican majority in November, but we need your help. Will you join me in this fight to save our great country?

| | Peter,

I'm not mincing any words—President Biden's decision, and Sean Casten's vocal support, to unfairly cancel student loan debt is going to screw over the middle class and working families.

People who opted to attend a trade school, start a small business, stay home to raise a family or paid their own debt shouldn't be saddled with the student debt of those who chose to incur them.

What's next? First, it's student loan forgiveness but what are extreme Washington politicians going to try and pull next?

Here's the thing: we've seen how detrimental it is to our communities when we let criminals back on the street with no accountability. Right now, we're on a path of no financial accountability.

**Is this the direction you want our country to go?** Help me stand up to President Biden and end Sean Casten's time in Congress [so we can put people over politics with $6 or $60 here](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=f6980fb504&e=7dd0b93d07)!

It's not just Republicans who are against the unfair student loan debt cancellation, [I spoke with Breitbart](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=50b0a9e72e&e=7dd0b93d07) about how people who have voted Democrat their whole life now disagree with Casten on just about every [issue](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=04d8fdb939&e=7dd0b93d07).

subject: FWD - The situation is getting serious now
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
#
Peter, after I emailed yesterday more than 200 grassroots donors stepped up and chipped in. It was our best fundraising email of the month.
I asked, and folks answered at a critical time — while our online fundraising is way down from last month. But we're still facing a steep fundraising dip. [**Can you chip in $3 to help us turn our fundraising around and get us back on track before midnight tomorrow night?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/16212?refcode=em20220830-1565&t=1&akid=1565%2E420207%2EO7gbD2)
\- Pramila
\-----Forwarded Message-----
Date: 8/29/2022
From: Pramila Jayapal
Subject: The situation is getting serious now
Peter,
I know that time is precious, so I’ll get straight to the point. Every week, month, and quarter, my team works hard to set ambitious but achievable fundraising goals. It’s essential we hit them.
This month, our fundraising projections are not looking good. **We’re 32% behind** where we were at this time last month. That’s a major drop in fundraising. **Put simply, we need to raise about $21,573 to hit our August goal.**
The situation is getting serious, and we need all hands on deck. I can’t emphasize it enough: it’s critical we raise that amount by Wednesday at midnight to stay on track.
[**I understand it’s a big ask, Peter, but every dollar adds up. So can I count on your $3 contribution to help us raise $21,573 by midnight on Wednesday?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/16212?refcode=em20220830-1565&t=2&akid=1565%2E420207%2EO7gbD2)
**[Contribute](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/16212?refcode=em20220830-1565&t=21&akid=1565%2E420207%2EO7gbD2)**
I won’t sugarcoat it: these numbers are very concerning. **We’re talking about a 32% decline in fundraising in only one month.**
In a field flooded with corporate money and super PACs, the odds are still stacked against progressives. **I don’t ask for donations for the sake of it.**
The funds we raise keep our campaign running – we never know what’s going to happen. They also allow me to support other progressive candidates on the ground and share resources in pivotal races.
I’m committed to this fight for the long haul, but that requires strong, sustained fundraising. **And to be honest, we are way behind.**
[**We have just two days to raise $21,573, so I have to ask again: will you donate $3 or any amount right now, so we can close this gap?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/16212?refcode=em20220830-1565&t=22&akid=1565%2E420207%2EO7gbD2)
In solidarity,
Pramila

**[Contribute](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-footer?refcode=em20220830-1565-footer&t=23&refcode2=1565_420207_O7gbD2&akid=1565%2E420207%2EO7gbD2)**

**If I’m not able to raise an additional $100,000 by August 31st, the national Republican Party wont’ send in the troops.**

body:
From: Gov. Kristi Noem
Dear Fellow Conservative,

Growing up, my dad told me every single day, “You don’t complain about things, you fix them.”

My dad was the hardest worker that I knew. He led by example and action. After he passed, I made the decision to be like my dad: a person of words and of action, because both matter. That’s why I ran for office. I am committed to always serving the people of South Dakota with both words and action. I will do what I say, and I will always tell you what I’m doing.

We learn important lessons from our fathers. My dad's lessons still resonate with me today. Our Founding Fathers taught us many such lessons. They taught us that freedom is a cause worth fighting for. "Give me liberty or give me death," Patrick Henry famously said. So many of the brave men who followed George Washington into battle died in the pursuit of that same liberty.

[**Help Republicans retake Congress
and save America. ⇒**](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=01d381d846914090b6c91ad187ef254f&_e=mhKUIBfnxtAX8L8wNu1wAqWvP7Lig9Lu3tbqvflLboHNqELFnEY8ZIgopHbLYdASJZdggNQpx9Pgl3am0SM-xc7OGBvPW5IGFURSqTKFdzeQvemwJv8GFrk0uFk8_FoqfmK0NYFbxPWB3Zouu9yneksGh3nDkygs4DwIuGmal9na3JGi0DjK3tQCvuryCK9FKkoJsgStmt3w0dALeCleyTLcSPE5pVkmRFvYkIKn8KhRQsDzdIXILwY_yRX-da1IWQmMktmq9ry40Qbvhwxt3eRmLJ7D3y9el5slXrmeG1WFlACFbHtXJL1R0nucTsIdxQEggc57-WSng6b4N2iXaZ49G5b3C-K4_Nl9-xlD8cf6c2jdUeQUFJUbcKZZDRKsrMnGENgVS68MRgObTCmrnXW9Nsq4P-ahuH0NbXn5XQMlXP8_xDSbY6Fvxt2Fu-INZLp1hcQNhYaraJWfF1X9bA%3D%3D)
It's easy to forget that before America's Founding, liberty wasn't widely recognized. The rights to "life, liberty, and the pursuit of happiness" that Thomas Jefferson wrote about were a controversial idea at the time. America was the first nation built around those rights.

The lessons that we learn from our fathers don't become less important just because we grow older. And the ideals laid out by our Founding Fathers are no less true in a 21st Century America. As we see threats to those ideals, to American freedom, we need to fight for them with the same vigor as Patrick Henry and the same resolve as George Washington.

[**Will you help us win back
our Republican majority? ⇒**](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=01d381d846914090b6c91ad187ef254f&_e=mhKUIBfnxtAX8L8wNu1wAqWvP7Lig9Lu3tbqvflLboHNqELFnEY8ZIgopHbLYdASJZdggNQpx9Pgl3am0SM-xc7OGBvPW5IGFURSqTKFdzeQvemwJv8GFrk0uFk8_FoqfmK0NYFbxPWB3Zouu9yneksGh3nDkygs4DwIuGmal9na3JGi0DjK3tQCvuryCK9FKkoJsgStmt3w0dALeCleyTLcSPE5pVkmRFvYkIKn8KhRQsDzdIXILwY_yRX-da1IWQmMktmq9ry40Qbvhwxt3eRmLJ7D3y9el5slXrmeG1WFlACFbHtXJL1R0nucTsId42NswyRyjliDEwfrCrfK3C1C5aCh6LTzCynxahe7Jy2bMrRV1JyhU9J8xFzi_MDfHdNXcP-UE2RVCGbizZGpM77DuVB5iLObdeIm7cby1cZirbRm6LQqOUe4MYpTFq3UN-UvOSewjpetW44KJ7zXRg%3D%3D)
We must fight for the future of our nation. Americans have no faith in Joe Biden and the Democrat Party. But we have not lost faith in ourselves. We will defend American values, rights, and freedoms. We will not let President Biden ruin this great country.

We can retake our Republican majority in November, but we need your help. Will you join me in this fight to save our great country?

clean_body: From: Gov. Kristi Noem Dear Fellow Conservative, Growing up, my dad told me every single day, “You don’t complain about things, you fix them.” My dad was the hardest worker that I knew. He led by example and action. After he passed, I made the decision to be like my dad: a person of words and of action, because both matter. That’s why I ran for office. I am committed to always serving the people of South Dakota with both words and action. I will do what I say, and I will always tell you what I’m doing. We learn important lessons from our fathers. My dad's lessons still resonate with me today. Our Founding Fathers taught us many such lessons. They taught us that freedom is a cause worth fighting for. "Give me liberty or give me death," Patrick Henry famously said. So many of the brave men who followed George Washington into battle died in the pursuit of that same liberty. It's easy to forget that before America's Founding, liberty wasn't widely recognized. The rights to "life, liberty, and the pursuit of happiness" that Thomas Jefferson wrote about were a controversial idea at the time. America was the first nation built around those rights. The lessons that we learn from our fathers don't become less important just because we grow older. And the ideals laid out by our Founding Fathers are no less true in a 21st Century America. As we see threats to those ideals, to American freedom, we need to fight for them with the same vigor as Patrick Henry and the same resolve as George Washington. We must fight for the future of our nation. Americans have no faith in Joe Biden and the Democrat Party. But we have not lost faith in ourselves. We will defend American values, rights, and freedoms. We will not let President Biden ruin this great country. We can retake our Republican majority in November, but we need your help. Will you join me in this fight to save our great country? I am excited to share with you the latest polls! We are closer than ever to DEFEATING Polis this November.
[](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-qyuikkl-ttjjilthht-r/) Hi Peter, **WE ARE CLOSE!** There are just 70 days left until the election! And our new campaign polling amplifies the [independent polling released by the Trafalgar Group](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-qyuikkl-ttjjilthht-y/) last week.**We WILL defeat Jared Polis on November 8th!** [](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-qyuikkl-ttjjilthht-j/) **[Click here for full results](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-qyuikkl-ttjjilthht-t/)**[**.**](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-qyuikkl-ttjjilthht-i/) The Trafalgar polling puts us a little more than 4 points behind the incumbent governor... with plenty of time to close the gap! What's more, when Colorado voters are educated on Jared Polis' positions on fentanyl, crime, and education, we pull within the margin of error. **Coloradans are realizing Polis is to blame for making our state the most dangerous place to raise a family.** For example, under Polis' leadership, 73% more people have died from fentanyl. That's despite the $11.1 billion he has spent in the name of prevention. According to our polling, **45% of voters are less likely to vote for him** once they learn about his inaction.Polis takes another major hit with **49% less likely to vote for him** when voters understand that Colorado is almost the worst in the nation when it comes to crime - the state ranks #1 in car thefts, property crime, and bank robberies.This polling shows a clear need to get the word out about just how bad crime is in Colorado and how Jared Polis' soft-on-crime policies are to blame. [](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-qyuikkl-ttjjilthht-d/) **[Click here to read](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-qyuikkl-ttjjilthht-h/)** **_We need to treat fentanyl as the weapon of mass destruction it is!_ **Please read and share the editorial I wrote with Colorado Springs Mayor, John Suthers, about the dangers of this poison. Colorado has reached a crisis point and Jared Polis and the Democrat-led legislature passed on the chance to do anything meaningful about it.**I will return this state to law and order and end Polis' soft-on-crime policies.** **Campaign Trail:** It has been a busy week for us! We wrapped it up at the Colorado State Fair. Thank you, Pueblo, for hosting! The support was incredible and we had so much fun! [](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-qyuikkl-ttjjilthht-k/) **Social Media Clicks:** The most popular post this past week was about a very special anniversary for me. Two years ago, I woke up from brain surgery with a new lease on life (and a headache haha).

I've always been a fighter - I lost my first husband in a plane crash when I was young, and fought back by building a business around my passion, dogs. When the Great Recession hit in 2008, I fought back by leading Camp Bow Wow through tough decisions which resulted in making it on the Inc. 500 fastest-growing companies list.

I came through the brain surgery feistier than ever, ready to take on the biggest fight of my life, to turn Colorado around for our kids. [](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-qyuikkl-ttjjilthht-u/) **Let's WIN back, Colorado!** I'm ready and willing to continue this fight for a brighter future, but I need your help! Please consider signing up to make calls, attend events, or, if you can afford it, make a donation to help get the word out. An easy way to show support is to display it on social media. Head to our website: **heidiforgovernor.com/action** to download one of these social media graphics. **MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

Now, let me tell you how this race affects you, Peter: No matter where you live, this race is going to impact you. How? If we lose Utah, you can expect even MORE tax hikes, open-borders, inflation increases, un-constitutional mandates, illegitimate loan bailouts, and pure chaos in America. But, if we keep this Utah seat Red, and win back the Senate - Republicans will have the power to keep Joe Biden and his cronies in check and get our country back on track. So now, you see why I had to email you today. What happens over the next 71 days, will affect our country and your life for decades to come. Everything is at stake, and I need you to pay attention before things get worse. For America, Mike Lee MEET MIKE: | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property. After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court. Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution.
